verses.text: ክፉዎችንና ዝንጉዎችን ለማራቅ፥ በመከራ ቀን ይገኙ ዘንድ ያላቸውን ምርጦችንና ጻድቃንን እንደ ባረከ የሚናገረው የሄኖክ ቃለ በረከት፤
ሄኖክም ተናገረ፤ እንዲህም አለ- “ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የሆነ ጻድቅ ሰው ዐይኖቹ ተገልጠው ሳለ- መላእክት ያሳዩኝን በሰማያት ያለ ቅዱስ ራእይ ያይ ነበር። ከእነርሱም ሁሉን ሰማሁ። እኔም የማየውን ዐወቅሁ።
ለዚህም ትውልድ አይደለም። ነገር ግን ለሚመጣው ለሩቁ ትውልድ ነው።
ስለ ተመረጡት ተናገርሁ። ስለ እነርሱም በምሳሌ እንዲህ አልሁ። ቅዱሱና ገናናው የዓለም ፈጣሪ ከማደሪያው ይወጣል።

ከዚያም በደብረ ሲና ተራራ ላይ ይቆማል፤ በሰፈሩ ይታያል፤ በኀይሉም ጽናት ከሰማይ ይገለጣል፤ ሁሉም ይፈራል፤ መላእክትም ይነዋወጣሉ፤ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻም ድረስ ፍርሀትና ታላቅ እንቅጥቅጥ ይይዛቸዋል። ረጃጅሞች ተራሮች ይደነግጣሉ። ረጃጅም ኮረብታዎችም ዝቅ ይላሉ። ከትኩሳቱም የተነሣ እንደ አደሮ ማር ይቀልጣሉ። ምድርም ትሰጥማለች። በምድርም ላይ ያለ ሁሉ ይጠፋል።
ፍርድ በሁሉም ላይ በጻድቃንም ሁሉ ላይ ይሆናል።
ለጻድቃን ግን ሰላምን ያደርግላቸዋል፤ የተመረጡትንም ይጠብቃቸዋል፤ ለእነርሱም ይቅርታ ይደረግላቸዋል።
ሁሉም የአምላክ ገንዘቦች ይሆናሉ። ይከናወናሉ፤ ይባረካሉ፤ የአምላክም ብርሃን ይበራላቸዋል።
ፍርድን ያደርግላቸው ዘንድ እነሆ፥ ከብዙ ቅዱሳን ጋር ይመጣል፤ ዝንጉዎችንም ያጠፋቸዋል፤ ኃጥኣንና ዝንጉዎች ፈጽመው በእርሱ ላይ ስለ አደረጉት ሁሉ ሥጋዊዉን ሁሉ ይወቅሳል።
በሰማይ የሚኖሩ ብርሃናት መንገዳቸውን እንዴት እንደማይለውጡ፥ ሁሉም እንደሚወጣና እንደሚገባ፥ ሁሉም በየዘመኑ እንደ ተሠራ፥ ከሥርዐታቸውም እንደማይተላለፉ በሰማይ ያለውን ሥራ ሁሉ ተረዱ።
Behold the earth, from the beginning to the end, consider all the work of God that is done upon it, for it shall not change.
In the spring, and in the winter, behold; the whole earth is as if it has been submerged in water, look upon the clouds and the rain, as they descend upon her.
From the first to the last, for two and three years, all trees except for the ten and four trees that do not wither, are bare; their leaves are all shed, observe how they appear; indeed, they are.
The sun also, as it rises upon the earth, is like the springtime; behold the seasons of spring.
But you seek the sun, the light and the brightness; the earth shall be darkened as it rises from the shadows.
But you cannot choose the earth and her stones for her brightness.
Observe how the trees are stripped bare, and how they are made desolate.
Consider all things; for He who lives forever, the Eternal One, created all these things as you have known.
The work that is to be done each year is before Him, and all creation belongs to Him. They shall not change, yet God shall do all things as He has created them.
The seas and the rivers are one, and behold how they accomplish their work.
But ye have not heeded; neither have ye kept the command of the Lord. Yet ye have spoken great and lofty words with your mouths, and your hearts have been far from peace.
Therefore, ye shall be cast away from your time; ye shall forsake the time of life; the glory of eternity shall be multiplied. And it shall not be a cause for regret unto you.
In those days, peace shall be unto all the righteous in the world.
But unto the chosen shall be light, love,
And they shall inherit the earth. But unto you, the wicked, shall be a cause for sorrow.
At that time, wisdom shall be given unto the chosen; and they shall all live in life; whether in humility or in pride, they shall not be forsaken; yet wisdom shall possess them.
And the proud shall not be forsaken; and in the time of their life, they shall not be judged. They shall fulfill the number of their days of life, but in sin and in transgression they shall not die.
Their lives shall abound in peace. And the years of their joy shall be in laughter and in eternal peace; in all the time of their life, they shall abound.
And it came to pass, after the sons of men had multiplied, that this happened.
In those days, beautiful visions and heavenly appearances were born to women and daughters. The children of heaven, the angels, also appeared.
They said to one another, "Come, let us choose for ourselves wives from among the children of men."
Their leader, Samyaza, said, "I fear that perhaps you will not agree to do this deed, and I alone shall bear the great sin of this transgression."
And they all answered him, saying, "Let us all swear an oath not to abandon this counsel, and let us all bind ourselves together by mutual agreement; let us assist one another in this matter."
And at that time, they all became united in purpose; they assisted one another in their speech, and all were two hundred in number.
And they descended to a place called Ardis, which is the summit of Mount Hermon. And they called that mountain Hermon, for they had sworn and bound one another by mutual oaths.

And these are the names of their leaders: Samyaza, Urakabarameel, Ramiel, Kokabiel, Tamiel, Ramuel, Daniel, Ezekiel, Suruqual, Asael, Armaros, Batariel, Ananiel, Zaqiel, Samsapiel, Sartaqel, Turu'el, Yomyael, and Ariazael; these are the two hundred leaders of the angels, and all the others were with them.
And they took for themselves wives, each man choosing one for himself.
And they went to them and began to dwell with them, and they became one with them.
Teach them to show death and to demonstrate the act of dying. Consider the act of binding and the act of slaughtering.
And they cried out with a loud voice, saying, "We have given birth to a great multitude." Their number was three thousand.
And these people would consume them until they were satisfied; they would eat all that a man had grown weary of.
And the multitude of people would be consumed by them, and they would return to them.
They began to devour the birds and the beasts, those that move upon the earth and the fish of the sea.
They called each other by their flesh; they drank blood from her.
At that time, the earth was filled with the slain.
And Azazel taught men the sword and the shield, to make weapons and to work with iron.

And beneath them were the mountains, the valleys, the eyes of the earth, and the depths of the sea; from the chosen and the honored, from all that was honored and chosen, they showed them the way of destruction, all that would lead to death, and the changes of the world.
A great lamentation and much mourning was made. And behold, they were astonished; their paths were all lost.
Amizarak taught the showing of the stars, and he instructed all in the art of their counting. And Armoros also taught me the gathering of them.
In the distance, he taught the counting of the stars.
Kokabel also instructed in the showing of signs.
Timonel likewise taught the counting of the stars.
Asradel taught the course of the moon.
And among men, there was much lamentation; their words reached unto heaven.
At that time, Michael and Gabriel, Suriyal and Uriel, ascended to heaven.
They beheld much blood that was shed upon the earth, and all the violence that was committed upon the earth.
And they spoke among themselves in their cries, saying, "The earth alone has cried out unto heaven."
Even now, O holy ones of heaven, the souls of men are pleading for judgment before the Lord, and you shall be their intercessors.
To their Lord and to their King, they said: "Thou art the Lord of lords, the God of gods, and the King of kings."
"Thy sovereignty is for the generations of generations, and thy name is holy and glorious for all ages. Thou art also glorious in majesty."
"Thou hast created all things; all power is with Thee; all is manifest before Thee."
"Thou seest all things; there is none that can hide from Thee."
"Azazel, upon the earth, has committed all violence as it is taught, and in the heavens, those who serve Thee, and all that is in the world, is as it has been revealed; behold what he has done."
"With him in unity, let those who are with him be gathered; for the power Thou hast given is a sign of Thy authority."
"In unity, as men and women went forth, and with those women they mingled, as they have revealed their transgressions."
"Women also have given birth to violence; and thus, upon this earth, all blood and violence have returned."
"Behold now, the souls of the dead cry out; they shall rise even unto the heavens."
"Their cry has gone forth. Upon the earth, those who work iniquity cannot escape."
Thou art not without knowledge; for Thou knowest all things, even this and that which is theirs.
There is nothing that we may speak unto Thee. Therefore, what shall we do concerning this?
And at that time, the Most High spoke, saying, "I have sent my servant Noah to you, my son, to warn you."
Thus it is said, "In my name, let your head be turned; for the whole earth shall perish, and let the coming judgment be made known."
A flood of destruction shall come upon all the earth; and all that is within it shall be consumed.
Even now, let him flee, for he shall dwell upon all the earth; instruct them accordingly."
And the Lord God commanded Raphael, saying, "Take Azazel by his hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness."
And in the wilderness of Dudael, he shall be opened; and there he shall be cast into the darkness; and upon him shall be heavy stones and sharp rocks.

Let him not wear darkness; and there he shall remain until the end of the age; let him not see the light, and let his face be turned towards the great day of judgment, that he may be sent into the abyss.

And the whole earth was destroyed by the work of Azazel; all sin was written upon him."

And the Lord said unto Gabriel, "Go forth upon the singers and upon the speaking men, and upon the children of the faithful; go forth upon the children of the faithful and upon the children of the righteous."
"And they shall be cast out, each one of them, for they have no length of days, and they shall perish in battle."

"For they shall hope to dwell in the life of eternity; for each one of them shall hope to live five hundred years, and all shall be called unto them; for concerning them, it shall not be unto their fathers."
And the Lord said unto Michael, "Go thou and speak unto the faithful; concerning all their transgressions, let them perish with the women, and speak unto others also."

"And all their children, when they shall be in the time of their tribulation, and when they shall see the destruction of their beloved, until the day of their judgment and until the end of their days, shall be made to serve upon the earth beneath the earth until the judgment of eternity is fulfilled."
"And in those days, they shall be taken under the fire unto the place of the abyss; and in the house of bondage, they shall be prepared for eternity."
"And from that time forth, they shall be joined with them until the end of eternity; they shall perish, and until the end of the generation of generations, they shall be preserved."

"For they have been cast out among men, and all the wicked men and the children of the righteous shall be destroyed; and all evil from the face of the earth shall be cut off; and all wicked works shall be destroyed; and the tree of righteousness and of truth shall be revealed for eternity."
"And all their works shall be for blessing; for righteousness and truth shall be established for eternity with joy."
"Even now shall all the righteous be gathered; and until a thousand children are born, they shall remain alive."
Their childhood and their youth shall all be fulfilled in peace.
In those days, the earth shall truly be at rest; and all the trees thereof shall be planted; and it shall be filled with blessing.
All the trees of joy shall be planted upon her; and the vines shall be planted upon her; and the wine that is planted upon her shall yield fruit for the joy of the heart.
One measure shall be a thousand measures; and one measure of oil shall be ten measures of oil.

But you shall be cleansed from all that is wicked, from all that is unclean, from all that is sinful, and from all that is abominable; and you shall cleanse the earth from all the wickedness that is done upon it.
And upon the earth, they shall be destroyed; and all the children of men shall be righteous; and all nations shall be those who honor and praise Me.
All shall worship Me; and the earth shall be freed from all destruction, from all sin, from all defilement, and from all sorrow.
For generation to generation, and unto eternity, she shall not be deprived of the waters of destruction.
"In those days, concerning the works and the afflictions of the children of men, I shall open the storehouse of blessings that is in the heavens to bring them down to the earth."
Peace and joy shall be in unity in this world for all generations, and in the generation of the children, they shall all be one."
Before all things, Enoch was taken away.
And concerning the sons of men, there was no one who knew what had befallen him or where he had gone.
In his time, all his works were with the holy ones and the righteous.
And I, Enoch, began to give thanks to the Great Lord, the King of the world.
Behold, the righteous ones called me, Enoch the scribe.
And they said to me, "The scribe of the righteous, Enoch, go to the highest heaven and to the holy place that is eternal, and speak to the righteous ones."
And they mingled with women; and the sons of men did as they pleased.
They took wives for themselves, and on the earth, they committed great transgression.
And there was no peace upon the earth, nor was there any restraint of sin.
And their children did not find joy, for they beheld the death of their beloved; and their children cried out in distress.
"They shall call upon the everlasting, yet mercy and peace shall not be granted unto them."
And Enoch went and said unto Azazel, "Peace shall not be granted unto thee."
A great judgment has gone forth against thee to destroy thee.
Because of thy teaching of violence, and for the sight of the children of men, all works of violence and sin shall not be granted unto thee, neither shall there be rest or prayer, nor forgiveness.
At that time, he went and spoke unto all in unity.
And they all feared; terror and trembling seized them.
That their prayer may be a reminder unto the Lord God, that it may be a means of atonement for sin, that I may write their prayer as a reminder unto them.
They shall not be able to speak from this day forth, for the evil that has befallen them has caused their eyes to be turned upward to heaven, yet they cannot see.
And at that time, concerning their bodies and concerning each of their deeds, that their prayer may be a means of atonement and a length of time, I shall write their prayer and their remembrance.
And I sat by the waters of Dan, and behold, this is she who is on the right side from the west of Hermon.
I spoke of your remembrance until the end of your desires.
Behold, a dream came to me; visions were revealed to me.
I shall speak concerning the children of heaven; I saw a vision of the holy ones.
I arose and went unto them; and they were all gathered together, having their faces covered, as they were in the midst of Lebanon and Senser.
And I spoke of all the visions that I had seen before them.
And I began to speak those words of righteousness, to instruct the children of heaven.
This is the book of the righteous, which was revealed in this vision, beginning from ancient times, concerning the holy ones who dwell in heaven.

In the flesh, I beheld and saw what I speak of today; the holy God shall speak unto them, that they may remember in their hearts, and He gave the mouth to men; and He also gave them the word of knowledge.
He created me; He gave me to instruct the children of heaven.
I have written your supplication.
In my vision, it was shown to me thus: Do not make your supplications unto the world in all its time.
The final judgment has come upon you; it shall not be for your benefit.
From this day forth, until the world shall cease, do not ascend unto heaven.
In all the times of the world, what you have spoken shall be declared upon the earth.
Before this, do not bring ruin upon your children whom you love.
Before you, they shall not be slain by the sword, yet their cries shall not be heard by you.
Concerning you and concerning them, the supplication you have made shall not be granted unto you.
And you, while you are troubled and while you are distressed, do not speak a word from the book I have written unto you.
And to me, thus was a vision seen.
Behold, the clouds shall call upon me in vision; they shall summon me in silence.
The stars and the lights do indeed trouble me; they cause me distress.
The winds do indeed blow upon my sight; they cause me distress. They have lifted me up to the heights and to the heavens.
I entered until I approached the wall that was made of thick stone.
The fire shall be kindled upon me, and it has begun to terrify me.
I entered unto the fire, and I approached the great house that was made of thick stone.
And the wall of that house is made as if it were of thick stone.
The earth is of stone, and the heavens are as stars and lights that run swiftly.
Among them are the fiery beings, the cherubim. Their heavens are as water.
And there is fire that burns around the gate; the wicked shall be consumed by the fire.
And I entered into that house; it shall be as fire that burns; it shall be as stone that melts.
There is no joy or life within me; fear has overwhelmed me, and trembling has seized me; as I was in anguish and in distress, I fell upon the threshold, and I could not see with my eyes.
Behold, there is another house greater than this one.
Before me, all is opened, it is made of fire.
Concerning His glory and His majesty, I shall speak unto you until I am unable; in all things, in brightness and in honor, in majesty, He shall be exalted.
And there is a fire, and above it is brightness, and the movement of the stars is there; the fire that descends from the heavens is indeed a flame.
Within it, I beheld a high ceiling.
Its form is as that of a cherub, and its brightness is as the sun that shines; the voice of the cherubim is heard.
From beneath the great ceiling, the fiery streams shall flow; they cannot be seen.
The Lord of glory is seated upon it; His radiance shines brighter than the sun, and it is purer than all snow.
No one from among the angels may enter unto Him, nor behold the face of His glory and of His majesty; no fleshly man may gaze upon that fire and live.
And there is a fire that burns around Him, and before Him stands a great fire.
And there is none that draws near to Him from around, for there are many, many angels before Him.
Yet He does not accept any special counsel.
And the saints that draw near to Him do not cease by day or by night, nor do they depart from Him.
And I, until this time, was trembling, and my face was covered.
And the Lord, calling to me, said, "Enoch! Come near to this holy word."
And He brought me until I was near, but I, covering my face, was looking down.
And He answered me, saying this: "The righteous man who writes righteousness is Enoch; do not be afraid."
"Come near to this, and hear My word; concerning them, that you may speak to them, for I have sent you to heaven, saying this to them—
You ought to speak concerning man; however, concerning you, it is not so."
Why have you contended against the high heaven and the holy place that is eternal?
You have lain with women, and you have corrupted the daughters of men.
You have taken wives for yourselves; you have made them as the children of the earth, and you have begotten daughters of the giants.
But you, O holy ones who dwell in everlasting life, have corrupted yourselves with women.
You have begotten in fleshly blood, and you have lain with the blood of men, and they have worked in fleshly and bloody deeds as you have done.
These are they who shall die and perish; therefore, let your seed be upon them, that children may be born from them.
Such work shall be done upon the earth.
But you, before this, were the holy ones, who were not to perish, for you were the spirits of eternal life.
Therefore, I have not made for you women, for their dwelling is in heaven.
Now also from the spirit and from the flesh...
Their dwelling shall be upon the earth.
The souls of the wicked shall depart from their flesh; for their foundation hath been created above the holy ones.
In the beginning, the foundation that was upon the earth shall be a wicked spirit; and the wicked spirit shall be called by this name.
The spirits of the heavens shall have their dwelling in the heavens; and for those born upon the earth, their dwelling shall be upon the earth.
The spirits of the righteous who ascend to the clouds shall perish; they shall fall, and one shall cast them down upon another; and upon the earth, they shall be cast down.
They shall cause sorrow, and those who consume them shall find no sustenance.
They shall not be quenched, nor shall they be known.
For they have been born in the days of violence and destruction; therefore, these men shall not be cast upon the sons of men and upon the daughters.
The death of the wicked shall be as a departure from their flesh.
Let it be consumed.
Likewise, they shall be consumed without judgment; until the great day of reckoning, a judgment shall be executed that arises from the great world, from the wicked and the unjust.
Even now, concerning them, you should proclaim the message you have sent, as it was spoken to them in heaven by the righteous.
"Today, you are not in heaven; the mysteries have not yet been revealed to you."
You have known the hidden mystery, and in your hearts, you shall declare this to the women.
In this mystery, both women and men shall increase wickedness upon the earth; thus, peace shall not be among you."
As those who are to be cast out, lead me to a place where they dwell; when they are called, they shall appear as men.
A gentle breeze shall be where they are, and his own shall reach even to the heavens; lead me to the mountain.
I have seen four places of refuge; in the thickest of the thicket, there is a hiding place; there are the garments of fire and their coverings, and the sword of fire and all the flames are present.
The waters of life that speak and the fire of the west, until they bring me forth; behold, it is the entrance of the sun that all may behold.
I came until the fire was melted like water, until the fire was liquid; it shall melt toward the west and to the great sea.
I beheld all the great rivers; until I reached the great darkness, I journeyed, and I went toward all that is fleshly and that may be nourished.
I beheld the mountains that have winter's frost, and all the waters of the river that may be melted.
I beheld all the rivers of the earth, their mouths, and I beheld the mouth of the great one.
I beheld all the places of the winds; the foundations of the creation and of the earth, I beheld as they were established.
I beheld the stone of the earth's axis; I beheld the four winds that bear the earth and the heavens.
I beheld the heights of the heavens, the winds as they are like the wings of a bird.
They stand between heaven and earth; they are the messengers of heaven.
I beheld the winds that bring forth the heavens, the glory of the sun and all the stars that they may gather.
I beheld the clouds upon the earth, and the winds that bear them.
I beheld the way of the angels; and I saw the path that stretches above the earth, the abode of the heavens.
And I journeyed towards the wilderness, beyond the revered stone, to the place where the seven mountains rise.

Three are towards the east, and three are towards the wilderness. Yet behold, one in the east is called the mountain of the heights; one is called the mountain of the sea; and one is called the mountain of the blood. And the one in the wilderness is called the mountain of the red.
The middle one, however, is as a mountain called Peka, which reaches unto the heavens like the throne of the Lord.
And the mountain called Agoberu is there; and I beheld the fire that burns upon all the mountains.
There I beheld a great place that shall be the end of the earth; and there the waters shall gather.
In the heavens, I beheld the fires of the burning, and I saw the great chasm of the earth.
Within them are those that are consumed and those that descend; and I beheld the heavenly pillars that are not numbered, above and below.
And I beheld a place upon the chasm; for there is no abode above, nor foundation of the earth below.
There is no water above; nor do birds dwell therein; but it is a wilderness.
And there I beheld seven great mountains, in a manner that terrified me.
The angel also spoke to me, saying, "This place is the end of heaven and earth."
This is for the heaven of the stars and for the heavenly host, as a dwelling place for those who are consumed by fire among the stars.
And these did not come at their appointed time, but were sent forth before their departure, having fulfilled the command of the Lord.
In the time of mystery, they were bound until the end of their sins.
Uriel also said to me, "The angels
Their spirits have become many in form and have led the people astray; until the day of great judgment, they shall lead the sinners astray.
And their women shall be like the heavenly angels, as the daughters of peace.
I, Enoch, beheld the vision of all that shall come to pass; I alone saw the vision, and there was none among the children of men who saw what I saw.

And with me was one of the holy angels, Uriel, who guided me, and he said to me, "Enoch, why dost thou inquire? For whom dost thou seek to intercede?"
Behold, the angels who have been sent to command the Most High God.
And from there I went to a place that was more terrifying, to another location.
There I beheld a work that was terrifying; there was a great abyss that was both dreadful and deep; it was a place of torment, and it was a sea of fire, extending unto the end of the world.
And there were great pillars of fire that descended upon it, and I could not behold its measure or its height; my eyes were unable to perceive.
At that time I said, "How fearful is this place! It is a dreadful thing to behold."
Then one of the holy angels who was with me, Uriel, answered me and said,
"Enoch, what is this fear that hath come upon thee? Why dost thou tremble before this place of terror? What is this that causes thee to be dismayed?"
Thus I answered him, "This place is the house of detention for the angels; there they are held until the end of the world."
And from there I went to another place; I beheld a great and lofty mountain in the west, and it showed me the world that is to come.
There are four places in the abyss; within them is deep and wide, as if to swallow, yet it is indeed destined to swallow; for it is deep and dark to behold.
At that time, one of the holy angels, who was with me, Raphael, answered me.
And he said, "These places are made for the souls of the dead to gather; for the souls of the children of men shall all be gathered there."
Until the day of their judgment and until the time of their visitation, these places were created to hold them.
Indeed, it is a long time until the great torment that shall be upon them.
I have seen the souls of the children of men; they too, though dead, their words shall reach unto heaven; they shall be tormented.
At that time, I asked Raphael, who was with me, saying, "What soul is it that reaches unto heaven and is tormented?"

And he answered me, saying, "This soul is the brother of Abel, who was slain by violence; his seed shall be destroyed before the face of the earth until it perishes, and his offspring shall be separated from the seed of man until it perishes; he shall be tormented."
Then I inquired concerning him and concerning all judgment, saying, "Why is one different from another?"

And he answered me, saying, "These three souls were created to be separated from the souls of the dead; the soul of the righteous is thus distinguished; for it is a fountain of water that has light above it."
እንደዚሁም ለኃጥአን በሚሞቱበትና በምድር በሚቀበሩበት ጊዜ ሊኖሩበት ቦታ ተፈጠረላቸው።
በሕይወተ ሥጋ ሳሉ በእነርሱ ላይ ፍርድ አልተደረገባቸውም።
እስከ ታላቅዋም የፍርድ ቀን ድረስ በዚች ታላቅ ጭንቅ ላይ በዚያ ቦታ ነፍሶቻቸው ይለያሉ፤ ለሚራገሙም ሰዎች እስከ ዘለዓለም መቅሠፍትና ጭንቅ አለባቸው፤ ለነፍሳቸውም በቀል አለባት።
በዚያም ምንም እንኳ ከዓለም ጀምሮ ቢሆንም እስከ ዘለዓለሙ አስሮ ያግዛቸዋል፤
እንደዚሁም ለሚከስሱና በኃጥኣን ዘመን በተገደሉ ጊዜ ስለ ጥፋት ለሚያመለክቱ ሰዎች ነፍስ ቦታ ተለየ።
እንደዚሁም ፍጹማን በደለኞች ኃጥአንን እንጂ ጻድቃንን ላልሆኑ ለክፉዎች ሰዎች ነፍስም ቦታ ተፈጠረ፤ ከበደለኞችም ጋር እንደ እነርሱ ይሆናሉ።
ነፍሳቸው ግን በፍርድ ቀን አትገደልም፤ ከዚህም አይነሡም።”
ያንጊዜም የክብር ጌታን አመሰገንሁት፤ እስከ ዘለዓለሙ ድረስ ሁሉን የሚችል የክብርና የጽድቅ ጌታዬም የተመሰገነ ነው አልሁ።
ከዚያም እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ በምዕራብ በኩል ወደ ሌላ ቦታ ሄድሁ።
ሳያርፍ የሚነድና የሚሮጥ እሳትንም አየሁ፤ መቸም መች እንዲሁ ነው እንጂ በሌትና በቀን ከሩጫው አይገታም።
"What is this that has no rest?" I asked.
Then one of the holy angels who was with me, Raguel, answered me, saying, "As the sun rises in the west, this fire that you see is the brightness of all the heavens."
And then I journeyed to another place of the earth; and I beheld the mountains of fire that burn both by day and by night.
And there I turned aside, and I beheld seven glorious mountains.
All are different one from another; I beheld the glorious and the beautiful stones, all are glorious.
Their beauty is bright, and their appearance is lovely; three are towards the east, and one is upon another.
Three are towards the north; and one is upon another; there are great trees, and they are tall, and one does not draw near to another.
The seventh mountain is among these; its height, however, is like that of the throne of the Almighty, all resemble it.
The trees that have crowns are many; and in their midst is one tree, of which none has ever seen the time it has flourished.
Other trees like it do not wither; rather, they flourish more than all.
Its leaves and its flowers, and its wood shall not wither forever.
Its fruit is beautiful; its fruit, however, is like the fruit of the fig tree.
And it was said, "Behold, this tree is beautiful, it is pleasing to behold, its leaves are good, and its fruit is altogether delightful to see."
And at that time, one of the holy and mighty angels, Michael, who was with me, returned to me.
Thus I was told, "Enoch, why do you inquire about this tree? Why do you ponder to understand it?"
And then I, Enoch, answered him, saying, "I desire to know about everything, especially about this tree."

And he replied to me, saying, "What you see is a great mountain, resembling the throne of the Lord, a holy and mighty throne, where the King of glory, the Lord of the universe, will sit to judge the earth in the time of His descent."
This beautiful and magnificent tree shall remain until the great day of judgment, and until the time it is fulfilled for eternity; no man shall have the power to approach it.
This shall be given to the righteous and to the holy; from its fruit, life shall be granted to the chosen ones.
In the heavenly kingdom, in the house of the Lord, it shall be planted in a sacred place.
And at that time, they shall rejoice, and they shall perform gladness.
In their respective generations, they shall offer their incense in the holy place; your fathers, having lived for many ages, shall also dwell on the earth for many ages.
"In their time, neither anguish nor sorrow, neither poverty nor suffering shall befall them."
"For the righteous, thus have I prepared, and thus may they swiftly be given; I give thanks to the King of the ages, the Lord of glory."
"Then I went down to the midst of the earth; I beheld the blessed and the unblemished, the place where the branches that were cut off dwell."
"And there I saw the holy mountains; beneath the mountain, to the east, there is water; and it flows toward the north."
"To the east, I beheld another mountain rising."
"In the midst of them, there is a deep valley. It has no width; and in it, water flows toward the mountain."
"And in this second mountain, to the west, there is at least one mountain. Its height is not known; and in the midst of them, there is a deep valley."
"At the edges of the three mountains, there are also deep valleys and other dry ravines."
"All the ravines are deep; they have no breadth, for they are raised from the firmament."
"Upon them, trees shall be planted; because of the world, I was astonished; because of the ravine, I was astonished; indeed, I was greatly astonished."
And at that time I said, “Why is this land, which is blessed and adorned with two mighty trees, so?”
“Why is this land, which is adorned with a flowing stream among them, so?”
And at that time one of the holy angels who stood with me, Uriel, answered me and said, “This flowing stream is for those who are blessed until the end of the ages.”
And all who speak of matters unworthy before the Lord shall be gathered in that place.
Because they have spoken of matters concerning His glory, they shall be gathered there; and in the latter days, their judgment shall be there.
Truly, the type of judgment that will be is before the righteous, for eternity shall be upon them.
And those who show mercy shall be blessed by the King of glory, the Lord of the ages, and they shall give thanks there in all their days.
In the seasons appointed for them, they shall give thanks for His goodness.”
And I too, at that time, gave thanks to the Lord of glory, and as was fitting, I spoke of His greatness, and I called upon His name.
And from there, I journeyed towards the east, amidst the mountains of the wilderness.
I beheld only the wilderness.
However, it is a forest that has been enveloped by this seed.
The water also shall rise above, and my shadow shall be seen above as it is lifted up like a bird.
To the west, it shall be lifted as if it were being drawn; from the four corners, it shall flow forth, and then there shall be water and thirst.
From the wilderness, I went to another place and approached this mountain in the east.
There, I beheld the trees of judgment; moreover, I saw trees that bore white fruit and had the appearance of a vine, and the trees were not alike.
Upon him, and upon them, though far away, upon the mountain of the east,
I beheld another place where there is water that cannot be contained, belonging to the valleys.
I also beheld the beautiful tree; its fragrance is as the fragrance of the lily.
And beside these valleys, I beheld a mountain that was adorned with beauty.
And beyond these, I drew near to the east, and I beheld another mountain that was filled with trees within it.
From him, his name is Serira, and as it is said in my heart, like a stream that is without water, it shall be refreshed.
And upon that mountain, I beheld another mountain; and within it were trees that are called Wagira.
And those trees are like the cedar, strong and mighty; and when they bear fruit, they shall surpass all the beauty of the valley.
After these shrubs, I looked upon the mountains towards the east,
and I beheld seven mountains that were filled with trees called Amara, Kenanmos, and Pprere.
And then I went up upon those mountains, and I journeyed towards the east.
I traveled to Eritrea, and from there I became distant.
I ascended upon an angel called Zutsu'el; and I came unto the garden of righteousness.
And from these trees, I beheld many and great trees there in their glory.
Their fragrance was pleasant, and they were great indeed. Their brightness was abundant; they shone forth.
And from Him, I beheld a great tree of wisdom, wherein dwelt great understanding; it appeared to be majestic.
Its fruit was very pleasant, like that of the vine; and that tree's fragrance reached afar off.
Thus I said, "This tree is good; its form is beautiful and brings joy to my heart."
And the holy angel who was with me, Raphael, answered me, saying,
"This is the tree of wisdom, which thy forefather, thy father, and thy mother partook of before thee."
They also knew wisdom; their eyes were opened; they were aware of their nakedness; and they were cast out from paradise."
And from there, I journeyed until I reached the edge of the earth; and there I beheld great beasts.
One was different from the other; the faces of the beasts were distinct, their beauty was unique, and their voices varied one from another.
And I beheld the great beasts, and the heavens above them, where the earth's border was lifted, and the opened gates I saw.
I beheld how the stars of heaven went forth; and I counted the gates that went forth from them.
I wrote down every exit of each one, according to their numbers, and their names, and their ranks, and their dwellings, and their times, and their seasons, as the angel Uriel showed me.
He showed all things to me, and he wrote; and I also wrote their names, their orders, and their works.
Then I went to the earth's border and to the west; and there I saw a great and glorious place of wonders upon the earth.
There I beheld three of the heavenly gates opened in the sky; and from each of them the winds would go forth.
In the west, when the wind blew, there was cold and frost, and snow and ice, and the rain and the dew would fall; and from the window it would flow forth in goodness.
And when the two windows blew with power, there would be a great shaking upon the earth; and they would blow with might.
Then I went to the earth's border and to the north; and there I saw three windows opened, just as I had seen in the east, and their exits were likewise.
Then I went to the earth's border and to the south.

And I beheld, and lo, three gates were opened in heaven; and the first gate was called the gate of the east, and the second gate was called the gate of the north, and the third gate was called the gate of the south.
And I went forth through the gate of heaven towards the east.
And I beheld, and lo, three gates were opened in the eastern part of heaven.
And in these small gates, on each side, the heavenly stars do pass through.
And they shall go forth upon the path that is seen unto them, and they shall go towards the west.

And at the time when I beheld this, I gave thanks; that the creation might be revealed to the angels and to the souls of men, that they might give thanks for their work; and that all creation might see the work of His power, and that they might honor the great work of His hand; and that they might give thanks to Him for eternity, for the great and honored miracles He hath wrought, I shall always give thanks unto the Lord of glory.
For the second time, Enoch beheld a vision; the son of Adam, the son of woman, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Kenan, Enoch beheld this vision of wisdom.
To those who dwell upon the earth, I declare that which I began to speak concerning wisdom; this is the beginning.
O ye of old, hearken; and ye who have arisen after, consider the matters we speak before the Lord of spirits.
These say, “The first shall be better”; and we, the ones who have arisen after, do not regard the beginning of wisdom.
As I have thought, the chance of life eternal, which was given to me by the Lord of spirits, has not been granted to me until this day, as I have desired.
Three parables have been revealed unto me.
And I also began to speak unto those who dwell upon the earth.
The first parable is this: When the congregation of the righteous is made manifest, and the sinners are judged for their sins, at the time of their punishment before the earth.
Concerning the Lord of spirits, their works are revealed before the chosen righteous at the time when the righteous are made manifest.
To those who dwell upon the earth, for the righteous and for the chosen at the time of their revelation.
Where is the dwelling of the sinners? Where is the refuge of those who have provoked the Lord of spirits?

They were better in their former state before they were born; for when the glory of the righteous is revealed, they shall be judged in their wickedness; and before the righteous and the chosen, the proud shall be made known.
From today onward, those who possess the earth shall not be rulers nor lords.
They shall not be able to behold the face of the holy ones. For the glory of the Lord of spirits is revealed before the holy, the righteous, and the chosen.
At that time, the rulers shall be destroyed, and they shall be given into the hands of the righteous and the holy.
From then on, their life shall be utterly destroyed, and there shall be no one to intercede for them before the Lord of spirits.
In those days, it shall be thus, the children of the chosen and the holy.
In those days, Enoch wrote the books of the signs and of wrath, and the books of the vision and of the punishment.
And the Lord of spirits shall not show mercy upon them.
At that time, clouds and thick winds shall be seen before the earth, and the heavens shall be opened.
And there, I beheld another vision; I saw the dwelling place of the righteous and the resting place of the saints.
And there, my eyes beheld their dwelling place with the angels, and their resting place with the saints.
Concerning the children of men, they shall lament, they shall be born, and they shall pray.
Righteousness shall flow before them like water; and mercy shall be upon the earth like a flood; and among them, it shall be thus for eternity.
And there, my eyes beheld the place of those chosen in righteousness and faith.
In their time, righteousness shall prevail, for the righteous and the chosen shall have no number before Him for eternity.
From the Lord of spirits, I beheld their dwelling place beneath the throne.
The righteous and all the chosen shall shine before Him like the brightness of fire.
Their mouths shall be filled with blessings, and from their lips, they shall give thanks to the name of the Lord of spirits.
Righteousness shall not be lacking before Him, nor shall the truth be hindered before Him.
And there I shall dwell, and my soul shall rejoice in that place.
Before the Lord of spirits, I have thus prayed for myself, that my ancient fortune may be there.
And in those days, I gave thanks to the name of the Lord of spirits, and I exalted Him greatly; for the Lord of spirits has blessed me and honored me, and I have given Him blessings and glory.
Yet my eyes behold that place.
Thus I said, I have honored Him, and I have given thanks to Him—"Blessed is He, from ancient times until eternity, may we give thanks."
There is no end before Him.
Before the world was created, He knows what this world is; He knows also what shall be for the generations of generations.
Those who do not forget shall give thanks to You, and before Your majesty, they shall stand.
Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of spirits, Your creation also.
And in that place, all who do not forget shall stand before Him, giving thanks, and my eyes shall behold.
"Thou art blessed, O Lord, and the name of the Lord of hosts is blessed forever." Thus they say.
"My face was changed until I saw."

ስማቸውንም ዐወቅሁ፤ ስማቸውንም የነገረኝ ከእኔ ጋራ የመጣው መልአክ ነው።
የተሰወረውንም ሁሉ ገለጠልኝ፥ የእነዚያን የአራቱን ገጻት ቃላትም በክብር ጌታ ፊት ሲያመሰግኑ ሰማሁ።
መጀመሪያውም ቃል የመናፍስት ጌታን ለዘለዓለሙ ያመሰግነዋል።
ሁለተኛውንም ቃል የተመረጠውንና በመናፍስት ጌታ የታመኑ ምርጦችን ሲያመሰግናቸው ሰማሁ።
ሦስተኛውንም ቃል በምድር ስለሚኖሩ፥ በመናፍስት ጌታ ስምም ስለሚማልዱ ሰዎች ሲለምንና ሲጸልይ ሰማሁ።
አራተኛውንም ቃል ሰይጣናትን አስወጥቶ ሲሰዳቸው ሰማሁ።
በምድር የሚኖሩ ሰዎችንም ያጣሏቸው ዘንድ ወደ መናፍስት ጌታ እንዲገቡ አይተዋቸውም።
ከዚህም በኋላ ከእኔ ጋራ የሚሄደውን፥ የተሰወረውንም ሁሉ የገለጠልኝን የሰላም መልአክ፥
And I asked, saying, “To whom do these four faces belong, whom I have seen and whose words I have heard?”
And thus I said, “This is the first word, it is the archangel Michael, who is called the one of mercy and is separated from the time.”
The second is the holy Raphael, who is appointed over all sickness and is set over the children of men.
The third is the holy Gabriel, who is appointed over all armies.
The fourth is the holy Fanuel, who is appointed over those who shall inherit eternal life and is set over repentance.
Behold, these four are the archangels of the Most High God; and in that time, I heard their four words.
And after this, I beheld all the mysteries of the heavens.
I saw how the kingdom is established, and how the works of men are weighed in balance.
And there I beheld the dwelling places of the chosen, and the dwelling places of the righteous.
My eyes beheld the name of the Lord of spirits, and all the mighty ones were cast down from there.
And they were cast out, for there was no place for them to stand before the Lord of spirits.

And there I beheld the mysteries of the luminaries and the secrets of the winds, how they are divided upon the earth, and how the spirits of the winds are measured, and the mysteries of the clouds and of the dew.
And there I beheld the place from whence they proceed, and from thence the earth's inhabitants shall be gathered.
And there I beheld the storehouses of the winds; from those the spirits are released.
I beheld the register of the hail and the register of the snow, and the register of the clouds; and the cloud shall dwell above the earth from the beginning.
I also beheld the register of the sun and the register of the moon, how they proceed and where they go; their appearance is bright.
I beheld that one honors another, and their conduct is esteemed. The day does not pass, nor do they cease from their journey, nor do they grow weary.
They who dwell in silence shall keep their faith with one another.
The sun shall rise before all; the Lord of spirits shall command the way, and His name shall endure forever.
After this, I beheld the way of the moon, which was revealed and made known; the path of the way shall be traversed both by night and by day in that place.
Before the Lord of spirits, one hath seen the other.
Their rest is their thanksgiving, and they shall give Him praise; they shall honor Him, and they shall not grow weary, for the sun that shines upon them is for blessing and for much rejoicing.
The way of the moon is a return, for it was created in the name of the Lord of spirits; it is light for the righteous, but for the wicked, it is darkness.
He has given knowledge to man, and in the name of the righteous, He has established the knowledge of the righteous.
The chief shall not be reproached, nor shall the king be able to rebuke; for there is a fearsome one who examines all things; and all these shall be brought before Him.
ጥበብ የምታድርበትን ቦታ አላገኘችም፤ ማደሪያዋም በሰማያት አለ።
ጥበብ በሰው ልጆች ታድር ዘንድ ወጣች፤ ማደሪያንም አላገኘችም፤ ጥበብም ወደ ቦታዋ ተመለሰች፤ በመላእክትም መካከል አደረች።
ዐመፃ ከመዛግብትWa ወጣች፤ ያልወደደችውን አገኘች፤ ዝናም በምድረ በዳ፥ ጠልም በተጠማች ምድር እንደሚያድር በእነርሱ አደረች።
ሌሎች መብረቆችንና የሰማይ ከዋክብትንም አየሁ።
ሁሉንም በየስማቸው እንደሚጠራቸው፥ እነርሱም እንደሚሰሙት አየሁ።
በብርሃናቸውና በቦታቸው ስፋት ይመዘኑ ዘንድ የጽድቅ ሚዛኖችንም አየሁ።
የፍጥረታቸውንና የመመለሻቸውንም ቀን አየሁ፤ መብረቅ መብረቅን ይወልዳል። አመላለሳቸውም በመልአኮቻቸው ቍጥር ነው፤ ሃይማኖታቸውንም እርስ በርሳቸው ይጠብቃሉ።
ከእኔ ጋራ የሚሄደውንና የተሰወረውን የገለጠልኝን መልአክ ጠየቅሁት። እንዲህም አልሁት- “እነዚያ ምንድን ናቸው?”
እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ- “የመናፍስት ጌታ የእነርሱን ምሳሌ አሳየህ። እነዚህም በምድር ላይ የሚኖሩ፥ በመናፍስት ጌታም ስም ለዘለዓለሙ የሚያምኑ የጻድቃን ስሞች ናቸው።
ስለ መብረቅም ሌሎችን አየሁ፤ ከከዋክብት እንዴት እንደሚጸኑና መብረቅን እንደሚሆኑ አየሁ። ከእነርሱም ጋር
This is the second parable concerning the dwelling of the saints and the name of the Lord of spirits, which is to be revered.

They shall not ascend to heaven; nor shall they descend to the earth; the name of the Lord of spirits, which is to be revered, shall be as a day of affliction and distress, and thus shall the opportunity of the wicked be; on that day, the chosen one shall dwell upon the throne of His glory.
He shall choose their works and their places; nor shall they have a number.
I have chosen the holy and revered name that they shall sanctify.
On that day, I shall dwell among those whom I have chosen.
I shall cause the heavens to tremble, and for eternity I shall make them a blessing and a light. I shall cause the earth to tremble; for a blessing I shall make it.

I shall dwell within those whom I have chosen. Yet those who commit sin and iniquity shall not be spared; for I shall not allow the righteous to be harmed, and I shall uphold their peace, and they shall dwell before me.
To destroy the face of the earth, the judgment of the wicked has approached me.
And there I beheld a great glory, and His appearance was like that of a white cloud.
His form was like that of a man, and another was with Him. Grace was also upon Him; and His face was like one of the holy angels.
ከእኔ ጋራ የሚሄደውንና የተሰወረውን ሁሉ የገለጠልኝ ከቅዱሳን መላእክት አንዱን ስለዚሁ የሰው ልጅ ጠየቅሁት።
እንዲህም አልሁት- “ያ ማን ነው? እርሱስ ከወዴት ይሆን? ከብሉየ መዋዕልስ ጋር ስለምን ይኖራል?”
እርሱም መለሰልኝ እንዲህም አለኝ- “ጽድቅ የሆነለት፥ ጽድቅም ከእርሱ ጋር የኖረ የሰው ልጅ ነው። ጌታ እርሱን መርጧልና እርሱ የተሰወሩ መዛግብትን ሁሉ ይከፍታል።
ዕድሉ በመናፍስት ጌታ ፊት ለዘለዓለም በርትዕ ሁሉን ድል ያደረገ ነው።
“ይህም ያየኸው የሰው ልጅ ነገሥታቱንና ኀያላኑን ከአልጋዎቻቸው፥ ጽኑዓኑንም ከዙፋኖቻቸው ያስነሣቸዋል።
የጽኑዓኑንም ልጓሞች ይፈታል፥ የኃጥአንንም ጥርሶች ይሰብራል፤ ከፍ ከፍ አያደርጉትምና፥ አያመሰግኑትምምና፥ መንግሥትም ከየት እንደ ተሰጠቻቸው አያምኑምና ነገሥታትን ከዙፋናቸውና ከመንግሥታቸው ይገለብጣቸዋል።
የጽኑዓኑንም ፊት ይገለብጣል፤ ኀፍረትንም ይመላባቸዋል፥ ማደርያቸውም ጨለማን ይሆንባቸዋል።
ትሎችም ምንጣፍ ይሆኗቸዋል፤ የመናፍስትን ጌታ ስም ከፍ ከፍ አያደርጉምና ከመኝታቸው ይነሡ ዘንድ ተስፋ አያደርጉም።
እነርሱም የሰማይ ከዋክብትን የሚገዙ ሆነዋል፤ እጆቻቸውንም ወደ ልዑል ይዘረጋሉ፥ በምድር ይሄዳሉ፥ በውስጧም ይኖራሉ።
ዐመፅ ሥራቸውንም ሁሉ ይገልጣሉ፤ ሥራቸውም ሁሉ ዐመፅ ነው፥ ኀይላቸውም በባለጸግነታቸው ላይ ነው።
Their faith has become a snare unto them, for they have made the name of the Lord of spirits a covenant.
And from Him, those who believe in the name of the Lord of spirits shall be gathered together.
"In those days, the prayer of the righteous shall reach unto heaven, and the blood of the righteous shall be accepted before the Lord of spirits."
And in those days, the holy ones who dwell in heaven shall be one; they shall speak with one voice, they shall pray, and they shall give thanks.
For the blood of the righteous that was shed shall be praised in the name of the Lord of spirits, and they shall be blessed.
And their prayers shall be made for the eternal judgment, that they may not cease before the Lord of spirits.
In those days, I beheld a great throne, and its appearance was like that of a great cloud; and the writings of the living were revealed before Him.
And all the hosts that dwell in heaven shall stand around Him, and they shall stand before Him.
The heart of the holy ones shall be filled with joy; the number of the righteous shall be complete, and the prayer of the righteous shall be heard.
And the blood of the righteous shall be accepted before the Lord of spirits.
በዚያ ቦታ የማይቈጠር የጽድቅ ምንጭን አየሁ።
በዙሪያውም ብዙ የጥበብ ምንጮች ይከቡታል። የተጠሙ ሰዎችም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ይጠጣሉ፥ ጥበብንም ይሞላሉ።
ማደሪያቸውም ከጻድቃን፥ ከተመረጡትና ከቅዱሳን ጋር ነው።
በዚያችም ሰዓት ያ የሰው ልጅ በመናፍስት ጌታ ፊት ተጠራ።
ስሙም ከዕለታት መጀመሪያ የቀደመ ነው።
ፀሐይ፥ ምልክትም
እንዳይወድቁም እርሱን ይመረጐዙ ዘንድ ለጻድቃንና ለቅዱሳን በትር ይሆናል። እርሱም የአሕዛብ ብርሃን ነው፤ በልቡናቸው ላዘኑም እርሱ ተስፋ ይሆናል።
በምድር ላይ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ በፊቱ ወድቀው ይሰግዳሉ፤ ያመሰግኑታል፥ ያከብሩታልም፥ ለመናፍስት ጌታ ስምም ያዘምራሉ።
ስለዚህም አስታራቂ ሆነን፤ ይህም በመናፍስት ጌታ ፊት ከጥንት ጀምሮ እስከ ዘለዓለም ድረስ የተሰወረ ሆነ።
እርሱንም የመናፍስት ጌታ ጥበቡ ለጻድቃንና ለተመረጡት ገለጠው። የጻድቃንን ዕድል ፋንታ ጠብቋልና፤
This world of iniquity has been troubled, for they have called upon the name of the Lord in vain, and their works and their ways have been sought in deceit.
In His name they shall be delivered, and their poverty shall be removed.

In those days, in their distress and in their affliction, the kings of the earth and the mighty men who possess the earth did not recognize their own strength, and because of their deeds, their hands were weakened.
And in their choosing, men shall be sought after.
As the grass is consumed by fire, and as the rush is cast into water, so shall they be consumed before the righteous; and as they rise from the holy ones, they shall be given.
Their seeking shall not be found, and on the day of their distress, fear shall come upon the earth.

Before Him they shall fall, and they shall not rise; nor is there one who shall lift up his hand to help them; for the Lord of hosts, they have provoked, and the name of the Lord of hosts shall be praised.
Wisdom has been poured out like water; and glory shall not be diminished before Him forever; for in the secret of righteousness, all is mighty.
The oppressor shall perish before the Lord of hosts; as a vapor shall he vanish, and there shall be no place to stand.
His dominion is forever, and His power is for the generation of generations.
The spirit of wisdom, the spirit of understanding, the spirit of teaching and of power, the spirit that truly raises the righteous who have died, shall dwell in Him.
He shall judge those who are oppressed; there is none who can speak vain things before Him; for He is as a master of the spirit, a guide before Him.
In those days, she shall return to the saints and to the chosen ones; the light of the age shall shine upon them, and perfect glory shall be returned to the saints.
In the day of anguish, she shall deliver the wicked from their torment; and the righteous shall rise in the name of the Lord of spirits.
Let them enter into peace, and let their works of hands be laid down, that they may be revealed to others.
Before the Lord of spirits, honor shall be given to them, and in His name they shall be blessed.
His goodness is abundant; for in judgment and in His majesty, the righteous are known, and the Lord of spirits shall have mercy upon them.
Do not be dismayed in the time of judgment; for the unworthy shall vanish before Him, saying, "From now on, the Lord of spirits shall not have mercy upon them."
In those days, the earth shall return to its order; and the grave shall return to the order it has received.
Death shall be returned to its place; and they shall be blessed, for their day draws near, and the righteous and the saints shall be chosen from among them.
The exalted one shall dwell in those days upon His throne; and He shall reveal all the mysteries of wisdom from His chamber; for the Lord of spirits hath given and honored Him.
In those days, the mountains shall be like the hills; and the valleys shall be filled as the gardens of the earth.
In those days, the exalted one shall arise, and all shall be as angels in heaven. Their faces shall shine with joy.
The earth shall rejoice, and the righteous shall dwell therein; and the chosen ones shall live in her, returning as they are gathered.
And after those days, all the visions that were revealed unto me, I beheld in that place, and I was lifted up by the wind, and I was carried away to the west.
There, upon the earth, all the mysteries of heaven that are to be done, mine eyes beheld.
I saw the mountains of iron and the mountains of brass, the mountains of silver and the mountains of gold, the mountains of sapphire and the mountains of precious stones.
And I asked the angel that came with me, saying, “What are these that you do not know?”
And he answered me, saying, “All that you have seen shall be commanded, and upon the earth it shall be made great, and for the purpose of the mighty, they shall have power.”
And the angel of peace returned unto me, saying, “Fear not, for you shall see a little, the Lord of hosts shall strengthen you, and all that is revealed shall be made known unto you.”

These mountains which you have seen, the mountain of iron and the mountain of brass, the mountain of silver and the mountain of gold, the mountain of sapphire and the mountain of precious stones, all these shall be as a burning fire before the face of the astonished.
Above those mountains shall be as the waters descend. And beneath His feet shall be the weak.
“Thus shall it be in those days, whether it be of gold or of silver, they shall not be able to hide, nor shall they be able to speak or flee.”

Iron shall not be for the keeper, nor shall garments be for the cold, iron shall not be found, nor shall it be of any use, nor shall it be counted, nor shall it be desired; yet all these shall be revealed unto you.
"And the deceiver shall be cast away from before the Lord of spirits, for they shall not be hidden from the face of the earth."
"And then my eyes beheld a great abyss, and my mouth was opened."
"In every wilderness and in the sea, and all who dwell in the islands shall bring forth their hands, and they shall bring forth blessings and offerings; this great abyss shall not be filled."
"Their hands shall commit iniquity, and the wicked shall consume all that is destined for iniquity."
"From before the Lord of spirits, the wicked shall be destroyed; and the iniquity shall stand before the face of the earth."
"They shall not be judged for eternity, for they shall go to the angels of punishment, and they shall prepare all for the devil."
"And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying, 'To whom do these preparations belong?'"
"And he said to me, 'They shall be cast away, for these are prepared for the kings and mighty ones of this world.'"
"And after this, the true deceiver shall be revealed in the house of assembly."
"From henceforth, they shall no longer be called by the name of the Lord of spirits."
"All the mountains shall be made low before Him; and the hills shall be as a fountain of water; and the righteous shall be lifted up from the depths of sin."
"And I looked back and beheld another land, and there was fire descending, and I saw a deep abyss."
"They brought forth their kings and their mighty ones, and cast them into that deep abyss."
"And there my eyes beheld instruments of iron, lacking balance, as they were being forged."
"And I asked the angel of peace who was accompanying me, 'For whom are these instruments of iron prepared?'"
"And he said unto me, 'They are prepared for Azazel and his host, to be cast beneath the abyss.'"
"And the Lord of spirits shall bind them with heavy stones before them."
"Michael and Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, these shall bind them on that great day."
"On that day, as they are messengers of Satan, the Lord of spirits shall send fire upon them, and it shall consume them in the place of their abode."
"And on that day, the Lord of spirits shall bring forth judgment."
And all the gathering of waters that are above the heavens, and those that are beneath the heavens, and the fountains that are upon the earth shall be opened.
And all the waters shall be joined together with the waters that are above the heavens.
But the water that is above the heavens is indeed a source, and the water that is beneath the earth is a mere stream.
All who dwell upon the earth and all who dwell beneath the heavens shall be gathered together.
Therefore, let them acknowledge their transgressions that they have committed upon the earth; for this reason, they shall be consumed.”
ከዚህም በኋላ ብሉየ መዋዕል አዘነ፥ እንዲህም አለ- “በምድር ላይ የሚኖሩትን ሰዎች ሁሉ በከንቱ አጠፋኋቸው፤”
ከእንግዲህም ወዲያ በምድር ላይ በሚኖሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ እንዲህ እንደማያደርግ በገናና ስሙ ማለ።
እንዲህም አለ- “በሰማይ ምልክት አደርጋለሁ፥ ይህም በእነርሱና በእኔ መካከል በምድር ላይ የሰማይን ዘመን ያህል እስከ ዘለዓለም መተማመኛ ይሆናል።
ከዚህም በኋላ በመላእክት እጅ አጸናባቸው ዘንድ ብወድ በትእዛዜ ነው።
በችግርና በመከራ ቀን ከዚህ አስቀድሞ መዓቴም፥ መቅሠፍቴም ያድርባቸዋል።
የመናፍስት ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም በምድር የምትኖሩ ኀይለኞች ነገሥታት! እኔ የመረጥሁትን በጌትነቱ ዙፋን በሚቀመጥበት ጊዜ ታዩት ዘንድ አላችሁ አለ።
እርሱም በአዛዝኤልና በማኅበሩ ሁሉ፥ በሠራዊቱም ሁሉ ላይ በመናፍስት ጌታ ስም ይፈርዳል።”
በዚያም የመቅሠፍት መላእክትን ሠራዊት ሲሄዱ አየሁ፤ የብረትና የብርት ወጥመዶችንም ይዘዋል።

ያንጊዜም ያ ሸለቆ ከመረጧቸውና ከወደዷቸው የተነሣ ይሞላል።
የሕይወትም ቀናቸው ያልቃል፥ የስሕተታቸውም ቀን ከዛሬ በኋላ አይቈጠርም።
“በእነዚያም ወራቶች አለቆች ተሰብስበው ወደ ጳርቴና ወደ ሜድ ሰዎች ወደ ምሥራቅ ራሳቸውን ይመልሳሉ።
ነገሥታቱንም ያነቃንቋቸዋል፥ የሁከት መንፈስም ያድርባቸዋል፥ ከዙፋናቸውም ይገለብጧቸዋል።
እንደ አንበሶች ከመደባቸው፥ እንደ ተራቡ ጅቦችም ከመንጋዎቻቸው መካከል ይወጣሉ።
“ይዘምታሉ፥ የምርጦቻቸውንም ሀገር ይረግጣሉ፤ የእርሱ ምርጦች ሀገርም በፊታቸው መመላለሻና መገሥገሻ ትሆናለች።
የጻድቃኔ ከተማ ግን ለፈረሶቻቸው መሰናክል ትሆናለች።
እርስ በርሳቸውም ጦርነትን ያነሣሉ፤ ቀኝ እጃቸውም በእነርሱ ላይ ትጸናለች፥ ሰውም ባልንጀራውን፥ ወንድሙንም አያውቀውም።
ልጅም ከሞታቸው የተነሣ ሬሣቸው እስኪቈጠር ድረስ አባቱንና እናቱን አያውቅም። መቅሠፍታቸውም ከንቱ አይሆንም።
በእነዚያም ወራቶች መቃብር አፏን ትከፍታለች።
"They shall be received within it; yet it shall consume them, and when they rise up before the chosen, she shall cast them out."
"And after this, it came to pass that men sat down, and I beheld many others who were in the wilderness."
"And they shall come upon the winds from the east and from the west, even unto the day of equal measure."
"The voice of their wilderness was heard; and when this smiting was done, the saints were in heaven and knew it."
"The earth's foundations were shaken from their place."
"From the gates of heaven unto the gates of the earth, even unto the day of the trumpet, it was heard."
"All shall fall and bow down before the Lord of spirits."
"The conclusion of the second parable is this."
"Concerning the righteous and concerning the chosen, I began to speak of the third parable."
"You are the righteous and the chosen ones; your lot is indeed glorious."
The righteous shall shine as the sun, and those who are chosen shall be as the light of eternal life.
For their life, there is no end of days, nor do the saints have a number of years.
They shall seek the light, and in the Lord of spirits, they shall find righteousness.
In the Lord of spirits, there shall be peace for the righteous.
After this, the opportunity of faith shall be sought in heaven, for it shall be declared to the righteous as the secret of righteousness.
As the sun rises upon the earth, darkness shall pass away; and there shall be light that cannot be measured.
Formerly, darkness has passed away, and they shall not enter into the number of days.
The light shall shine before the Lord of spirits; the true judgment shall shine before the Lord of spirits forever.
In those days, my eyes beheld the mysteries of the righteous and the mysteries of the lights, and I saw their judgment.
The Lord of spirits shall bless them as He has desired for blessing and for glory.
And there I beheld the mystery of the cherubim; and in the heavens, at the appointed time, their words shall be heard.
He showed me the places of the cherubim.
The word of the cherubim is for peace and for blessing; even if it be for judgment, it is the word of the Lord of hosts.
After this, all the mysteries of light and of the glorious ones were revealed unto me.
They shall bring forth blessing and destruction.

And after Enoch was taken, in five hundred years, in the seventh month, on the fourteenth day of the month, I beheld a great multitude in the heavens above, as it were a great gathering, and I saw the hosts of the Most High as they were assembled.
Many, indeed, a multitude of angels did I see, and they were smiting with a great blow.
At that time, I beheld the throne of glory set in its place.
The angels and the righteous stood around it; and I was filled with great fear.
Fear seized me, and my heart trembled; I was separated; my second self was as one who had fainted; and I fell upon my face.
The holy Michael, one of the holy angels, came and raised me up.
And when he raised me, my soul returned to me; for I had not been able to endure the sight of the great vision and the blow, nor could I withstand the sight of the heavenly multitude.
The holy Michael said unto me, "What dost thou see, that thou art thus troubled?"
The day of mercy is until this day; the Lord is merciful; and upon those who dwell on the earth, the time of mercy is drawing near.

The Lord of hosts shall give true judgment to those who are judged; He shall give true judgment to those who are condemned; and He shall prepare for those who call upon His name in vain; the day of power, of judgment, and of retribution shall come upon you.
"This day is set apart for the chosen ones of the covenant, and it has been prepared as a day of trial for the wicked."
"On that day, the two eagles shall be separated; the one called the solitary eagle shall dwell upon the deep waters of the sea."
"The eagle that is not seen shall cry out in the wilderness; it is said that its name is the one that is called by the nations."

"And the name of the place shall be called the righteous, and the chosen ones shall dwell therein; for the Lord of spirits, who created them, shall be their beginning, and it shall be called Den Dayin, which is in the east of paradise, from the seventh of Adam."
"And I said, 'How shall I know that they are separated, one in the deep of the sea and the other in the wilderness?' I asked that second angel to reveal to me their strength."
"And he said unto me, 'Thou art a son of man; dost thou desire to know that which has been revealed unto thee?'"

"He who goes with me, the one who has been revealed, both the former and the latter, above in the heavens, and on the earth, in the deep, in the heavenly abode and in the foundation of heaven, and among the spirits, the second angel who has been revealed unto me."

"How the spirits are released and how they are measured, and the sources and spirits are released by the power of the spirit; the strength of the moon and its light, as it is the work of truth, and the portions of the stars are released according to their names, tell me."
"Each portion shall be released; and the locusts shall be heard in their dwelling; for every portion that is released has its measure."
"The lightning shall shine forth, and their army shall hasten to be heard; for there is a refuge for the locusts, and to the faithful, the word has been given."
The wind and the flame are not separated; each one moves in the breath.
The flame, when it is bright, gives forth the word of the wind, and they are not divided; the breath also, at that moment, shall be swift.
In their midst, it shall be equally divided; the place from which they emerge is like a whirlwind.
Among them, each one shall be caught in the whirlwind.
By the power of the wind, they shall be turned about; like the multitude of the earth's borders, so shall they move.
The spirit of the sea
Thus it stirs; upon the earth, all the mountains shall tremble.
The wind of the storm is his angel; the wind of the snow is a beautiful angel.
The wind of the tempest stands because of its strength; it alone has an angel.
From him, that which emerges is like a whirlwind; his name shall be called a mighty roar.

The Lord of the righteous shall not come in vain; after His mercy and His patience, judgment shall be upon them.
In those days, I beheld the angels of the Lord as they were given their measures.
And they took their wings and hastened unto the altar.
“And I asked the angel, ‘Why have they gone with these measures?’”
And he said unto me, “They have gone to measure.”
The angel that was with me said, “They shall bring forth the measures of the righteous and the instruments of the Lord of spirits in the name of the eternal.”
They shall begin to dwell with the chosen ones.
And these measures are given in faith and they shall declare the word of righteousness.
And these measures, which were lost in the wilderness, shall return on the day of the great gathering, and they shall declare all the mysteries of the earth.
There is none that shall perish before the Lord of spirits; there is none that can be lost.
For all that are in heaven and all the hosts shall receive the command; their word is one; and their brightness is as one fire.
They shall give thanks for that ancient word; they shall exalt it greatly; they shall honor it with wisdom.
In the matter and in the spirit of life, they shall be stirred; the Lord of spirits has established His throne in His glory.
In the heavens, the works of the saints shall be examined; the works of all shall be weighed in balance.
In the name of the Lord of spirits, the way of those who are called shall be examined, and in the presence of the Most High God, their true quest shall be sought at the appointed time.
All shall speak with one voice; they shall give thanks to the name of the Lord of spirits; they shall honor Him; they shall exalt Him greatly; they shall sanctify Him.
He calls upon all the hosts of heaven, and all the saints who dwell in glory.
The host of the Lord, the cherubim and seraphim, the archangels, all the mighty angels, and all the chosen angels,
In every place and in every land, on that day, they shall receive one word, united in the spirit of faith, in the spirit of wisdom and patience,
In the spirit of mercy, in the spirit of judgment and peace, in the spirit of kindness, they shall be blessed; they shall honor Him; they shall give thanks; they shall exalt Him greatly.
All shall say with one voice, "Blessed is He, the name of the Lord of spirits, forever and ever. Amen."
All who do not perish shall give thanks in the heavens unto eternity. All the saints who are in the heavens shall give thanks; all the chosen ones who dwell in the life of paradise shall give thanks.
To give thanks for Thy holy name, to honor and exalt it, and to sanctify it, all the spirits of light shall give thanks unto Thee.
All flesh shall glorify Thy name with great power unto eternity; they shall give thanks. For the Lord of spirits is abundant in mercy; He is far removed from the wicked.
All His works and all His power, and the measure of His works, shall be revealed in the name of the Lord of spirits unto the righteous and unto the chosen.
And the Lord commanded thus to the kings and the rulers, to the great ones and to those who dwell on the earth.
"You shall be able to know the one who is hidden; open your eyes and do not hide your authority," He said.
The Lord of spirits has seated Himself upon the throne of His glory; and the spirit of righteousness was revealed in Him.
And concerning the matter of the one who is hidden, He shall destroy all the mighty and all the sinners. And they shall perish from before Him.
And on that day, all the kings and rulers, the great ones and all who possess the earth shall stand.
They shall see that He is seated upon the throne of His glory; they shall know that righteousness shall judge before Him.
There is no voice that speaks before Him.
As a woman in labor is distressed, so shall her child be born in anguish; for the pain of childbirth shall come upon her.
The ones who are alike shall not be seen; they shall be troubled, and their faces shall be disfigured.
This son of man shall be seated upon the throne of His glory, and in that time, the anguish shall be upon him.
Kings and rulers, all who possess the earth, shall honor all that is forsaken; they shall give thanks and exalt Him on high.
From ancient times, the son of man has been forsaken; yet he is guarded before the mighty; and for the chosen ones, he shall be revealed; the holy ones and their chosen assembly shall be abundant.
On that day, all the chosen shall stand before Him.
Kings and rulers, all who possess the earth, shall fall before Him in their disgrace.
This son of man shall bring hope; they shall be born anew; and from him, they shall seek mercy.
After this, the Lord of the spirits shall hasten forth from before Him, and they shall be troubled.
Their faces shall be filled with shame; their countenance shall be added to their disgrace.
The angels of the Lord shall receive them, for they shall bring forth the children and those chosen by them to the people who have wronged them.
They shall be a refuge for the chosen and for the righteous.
And they shall rejoice in them; for the Lord of spirits shall pour out His wrath upon them, and the Lord of spirits shall cast them away from among them.
The righteous and the chosen shall be exalted on that day.
From now on, the wicked and the sinners shall not be seen; for the Lord of spirits shall guide them.
Then they shall dwell with the sons of men; they shall eat, they shall drink, they shall be filled, and they shall rise for eternity.
The righteous and the chosen shall rise from the earth; and they shall cast off their burdens.
They shall be clothed with garments of glory; and He shall be to them a garment of life before the Lord of spirits.
Your garments shall not wear out; and your glory shall not be diminished before the Lord of spirits.

In those days, the kings and rulers who possess the earth shall be scattered, and in the place where they were given, they shall be granted a little rest, that they may bow down before the Lord of spirits and be humbled, for they shall be reproached by the angels who were commanded to bring them low.
They shall confess their sins before Him; they shall give thanks to the Lord of spirits; they shall honor Him.
Thus they shall say: "O Lord of spirits, Lord of kings, Lord of rulers, Lord of the mighty, Lord of glory, Lord of wisdom, O God, blessed art Thou. All that is hidden shall be revealed in Thee."
Thy power is for the generation of generations; Thy dominion is for eternity.
Thy mystery is great; there is no number to it. There is no number to Thy goodness.
Now, let us honor the Lord of kings, and let us give thanks for Him who reigns over all kings, for we know Him."
Thus they said: "Let us honor Him, and let us give thanks to Him, for who shall grant us rest?"
Now we desire a little rest; yet we do not obtain it; we are scattered; yet we do not perish.
Light has passed away from us. Darkness is our dwelling place forever. Before Him we do not believe, nor do we give thanks to the Lord of spirits.
We do not give thanks to the Lord in all His works; our arrogance has been upon our kingdom and upon our dominion.
በድካማችንና በመከራችን ቀንም አላዳነንም።
እናምንም ዘንድ ዕረፍትን አናገኝም፤ ጌታችን በሥራው ሁሉ፥ በፍርዱና በቸርነቱም ሁሉ የታመነ ነውና።
የፍርዱንም ፊት አያገኙም፤ ስለ ሥራችንም ከፊቱ እንሄዳለን፤ ኀጢአታችንም ሁሉ በጽድቅ ተቈጠረ፤”
አሁንም እንዲህ ይሏቸዋል- “ሰውነታችን ከዐመፅ ገንዘብ ትጠግባለች፤ ወደ ሲኦል መከራ ትኩሳት ከመውረድም አታድነንም።”
ከዚህም በኋላ በዚያ በሰው ልጅ ፊት ፊታቸው ጨለማንና ኀፍረትን ይሞላል።
ከፊቱም ተሰድደው ይሄዳሉ፤ በመካከላቸውም በፊቱ ሰይፍ ያድራል።
የመናፍስትም ጌታ እንዲህ አለ- “የአዛዦችና የነገሥታት፥ የልዑላንና ምድርን የሚገዟት ሰዎች ሥርዐታቸው፥ ፍርዳቸውም በመናፍስት ጌታ ፊት ይህ ነው።”
በዚያም ቦታ የተሰወሩ ሌሎች ፊቶችን አየሁ።
የመልአኩንም ቃል እንዲህ ሲል ሰማሁ- “ከሰማይ ወደ ምድር የወረዱ፥ በስውር ያለውንም ለሰው ልጆች የገለጡ፥ ኀጢአትንም ይሠሩ ዘንድ የሰው ልጆችን ያሳትWaቸው መላእክት እኒህ ናቸው።”
በእነዚያም ወራቶች ኖኅ ምድር እንደ አዘነበለች፥ ጥፋትWaም እንደ ቀረበ አየ።
ከዚያም እግሩን አንሥቶ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ሄደ።
ለአያቱ ለሄኖክም ጮኸ፤ ኖኅም በመረረ ቃል ሦስት ጊዜ “ስማኝ፤ ስማኝ፤ ስማኝ” አለ።
እንዲህም አለው- “በምድር ላይ የሚሠራው ሥራ ምንድን ነው? ንገረኝ!
ምድር ደክማለችና፥ እንዲህ ተነዋውጣለችና፥ ምንአልባት እነሆ፥ እኔ ከእርስዋ ጋር እጠፋ ይሆን?”
በዚያም ጊዜ በምድር ላይ ታላቅ ሁከት ሆነ፤ ከሰማይም ቃል ተሰማ።
በግንባሬ ወደቅሁ፤ አያቴ ሄኖክም ወደ እኔ መጣ፤ በአጠገቤም ቆመ፤ እንዲህም አለኝ- “ወደ እኔ መራራ ጩኸትንና ልቅሶን ለምን ትጮኻለህ?
እርሱም- ጥፋታቸው ይሆን ዘንድ በምድር በሚኖሩ ሰዎች ላይ ከመናፍስት ጌታ ፊት ትእዛዝ ወጣ።
የመላእክትን ምሥጢር ሁሉ፥ የሰይጣናትን ግፍ ሁሉ፥ የተሰወረ ሥራቸውንም ሁሉ፥ ሟርት የሚያሟርቱ ሰዎችን ኀይል ሁሉ፥ የቀለማትንም ኀይል፥ የምድርን ሁሉ ጣዖት የሚሠሩ ሰዎችን ኀይል አሳውቀዋልና።
ብር ከመሬት ትቢያ እንዴት ይገኝ ነበር? ቅልቅል ብረትስ በምድር ላይ እንዴት ይገኝ ነበር?
They were not found upon the earth, for they were as the first source of the land and the angel that dwells within it, and they were neither flesh nor bone.
And after this, my father Henoch took me by the hand and raised me up.
Thus I said, "Because of the affliction upon the earth, I will call upon the Lord of the spirits, and I will go."
Thus I said, "Because of their wickedness, their judgment has been executed upon them; and because of their desires, the seasons shall not be counted before me."

And as the earth shall perish, so shall the people who dwell therein perish; and you have instructed those who have been taken away, for they are those who have been judged, and they have no return for eternity.
Nevertheless, my son! You are pure and good, as the Lord of spirits has acknowledged you, and this shall not be for you.
Among the holy ones, your name shall be exalted; and among those who dwell upon the earth, it shall be kept for you.
For the kingdom and much praise shall be yours; truly your seed shall be exalted, and from your seed shall arise the dwelling of the righteous and the holy; for they have no number for eternity."

And after this, I saw that all the people who dwell upon the earth were gathered for judgment and for destruction; and I was shown the angels of punishment, who were prepared to come forth with all the power of the waters beneath the earth.
And the Lord of spirits commanded those angels to be bound in the power of the waters, that they should not lift their hands against those who had gone forth, but that they should keep them.
And I went forth before Enoch.
And in those days the word of the Lord came unto me.
Thus said He unto me, "Noah! Behold, your opportunity has come unto me; it is an opportunity of love and righteousness that has no equal."
Even now the angels prepare the trees; and they shall bear a message at the time of their coming, and I shall keep my hand upon it.
And from her you shall go forth, and you shall be the seed of life; let the earth not remain barren, but let it be fruitful.
I shall establish your seed before me forever; and those who dwell with you, your offspring, shall I multiply upon the earth.
In the spirit of the Lord, His name shall be magnified upon the earth; and He shall be blessed.
The angels who show the vision of the abyss,
A great blow and the tumult of waters shall be upon our valley.
And all this came to pass, and after it, from the fire that arose, there was a great sound of lamentation in that place, and it was joined with those waters.
ያችም ሰውን የአሳቱ የመላእክት
የእሳት ፈሳሾችም በምድር ላይ የሚኖሩትን ያሳትWaቸው መላእክት በሚኰነኑበት ቦታ ወደ ሸለቆዎችዋ ይፈስሳሉ።
በእነዚያም ወራት እነዚህ ውኃዎች ለነገሥታቱና ለአዛዦች፥ ለልዑላንና በምድር ለሚኖሩ ሰዎች፥ ለነፍስና ለሥጋ ፈውስ፥ ለመንፈስም ፍርድ ይሆናሉ።
የመናፍስት ጌታን ክደውታልና በሥጋቸው ይፈረድባቸው ዘንድ ልቡናቸው ዋዛ ነገርን ይመላል።
የየቀኑን ሁሉ ፍርዳቸውንም ያያሉ፤ በስሙም አያምኑም።
በመናፍስት ጌታ ፊት ዋዛ ፈዛዛ የሚናገር የለምና፥ ሥጋቸው ብዙ ጊዜ እንደ ተቃጠለ እንደዚሁ በነፍሳቸው ለዘለዓለሙ ለውጥ ይኖርባቸዋል።
በእነርሱ ላይ ፍርድ ትመጣለችና፥ በሥጋቸውም ዋዛ ነገር ያምናሉና፥ የጌታንም መንፈስ ይክዳሉና።
በዚያም ወራት እነዚያ ውኃዎች ለውጥ ይኖራቸዋል፤ እነዚያ መላእክት በሚፈረድባቸው ጊዜ በዚያ ወራት የእነዚያ የውኃዎች ምንጮች መቃጠል ይለወጣልና።
መላእክትም በወጡ ጊዜ የምንጮች ውኃ ተለውጦ ይቀዘቅዛል።
ቅዱስ ሚካኤልንም እንዲህ ብሎ ሲመልስ ሰማሁት- “አለቆች የሚቀጡባት ይህች ፍርድ ለነገሥታትና ምድርን ለሚቈጣጠሩ አዛዦች ምስክር ናት፤ እኒህ የቅጣት ውኃዎች ለአለቆች ሥጋ ፈውስ፥ ለሥጋቸውም ለሞት ናቸውና።”
Those waters shall be turned into a fire that shall burn forever; they shall not see it, nor shall they believe it.
After this, my father Enoch gave me all the secrets that were entrusted to him, and the sign of the parables in a book; he added them to the words of the book that were with me.
And on that day, the holy Michael spoke thus to the holy Raphael: “The spirit of strength shall take hold of me.”
For the rulers have been judged, and concerning the distress of judgment, it has troubled me greatly.
While you work, who among them can bear the burden of the distress that has befallen them?
Again, the holy Michael spoke thus to Raphael: “Who is it that does not tremble at her heart?”
And as such, who among them can be known, when the word of judgment has arisen against them?

In the presence of the Lord of spirits, while standing, it was thus: the holy Michael said to Raphael, “The Lord of spirits has taken hold of them, and in the eyes of the Lord, mercy shall not be shown to them.”
For they shall work in the Lord, therefore, a judgment that has been decreed for eternity shall come upon them.
They alone shall receive their judgment for eternity; neither angel nor man shall receive a portion from another.
After this judgment, they shall be made to tremble; they shall also be made sorrowful. For it has been shown to those who dwell upon the earth.
And behold, the names of those angels are these; their names are as follows.
Their leader is Samaziah; the second is Arstikifa; the third is Armin; the fourth is Kokabiel.
The fifth is Turiel; the sixth is Rumial; the seventh is Daniel; the eighth is Mikail; the ninth is Bereqiel; the tenth is Azazel; the eleventh is Armaros; the twelfth is Batarial.
The thirteenth is Sesakiel; the fourteenth is Ananiel; the fifteenth is Turial; the sixteenth is Simsaphael.
The seventeenth is Yithrael; the eighteenth is Tumiel; the nineteenth is Turael; the twentieth is Ramuel; the twenty-first is Azazel.
These are the leaders of the legions.
The leader of a hundred and the leader of fifty, and the leader of ten, their names are as follows— the first of them is Yiqon.
Of the angels
The second name is Asbiel; this is for the holy angels.
The third name is Gadriel; he is the one who teaches all men’s children to slay and to kill.
He is the one who shows the way; for the children of men, he teaches the weapons of death, the dagger and the sword for slaughter.
ለሰው ልጆችም የግድያ መሣሪያዎችን ሁሉ አስተማረ፤ ከዚያች ቀንም ጀምሮ እስከ ዘለዓለሙ ድረስ በምድር በሚኖሩ ሰዎች ላይ ይህ ሁሉ ከእርሱ ወጣ።
አራተኛውም ስሙ ፔንሙዕ ነው፤ ለሰው ልጆችም የመረረውንና የጣፈጠውን ያሳየ ይህ ነው።
የተሰወረ ጥበባቸውን ሁሉ አሳያቸው፤ ለሰዎችም በጥቁር ቀለምና በወረቀት መጽሐፍ መጻፍን አስተማራቸው።
ስለዚህም ነገር ከጥንት ጀምሮ እስከ ዘለዓለም፥ እስከዚችም ቀን ድረስ ብዙ ሰዎች ይስታሉ። እንደ መላእክት ጻድቃንና ንጹሓን ሆነው ይኖሩ ዘንድ ነው እንጂ ሰው ለእንደዚህ ያለ ሥራ አልተፈጠረም ነበርና፥ በቀይ ቀለምና በጥቁር ቀለምም ሃይማኖታቸውን ሊያጸኑ ሰው ለእንዲህ ያለ ሥራ አልተወለደም ነበርና።
ይህን በማወቃቸው ይጠፋሉ እንጂ ሁሉን የሚያጠፋ ሞት ባልዳሰሳቸውም ነበር።
ስለዚህም ኀይል ይበላኛል።
አምስተኛውም ስሙ ካሳድያዕ ነው፤ የነፍሳትንና የአጋንንትን ክፉ መማታትን ሁሉ ለሰው ልጆች ያሳየ እርሱ ነው።
