In the time when the Most High dwelt in majesty, He revealed to the saints the head of the assembly, this is the number of His name.
His name is also called Beqa; thus spoke the holy Michael, saying, "Let them know the name of the one who has been named, that they may declare the name of the one who has been named."
And let all that has been named be shown to the children of men, that they may call upon it in the time of assembly, and may declare it.
For He is mighty, and He is the one who preserves; this is the might of the assembly.
This name, which is called Akai, was held in the hand of the holy Michael. The mysteries of this name are these: they are hidden in His name.
By this name, the heavens were established; this name was before the world was created; it shall endure forever, and the earth was founded upon its waters.
From the depths of the mountains, the waters that have been hidden since ancient times shall be poured forth until the end of the age.
By this name, the sea was created; and when it was stirred, from the creation of the world until the end of the age, it was established that it should not be moved.
By this name, all the creatures stood firm; from ancient times until the end of the age, they shall not depart from their place.
By this name, the sun and the moon shall shine upon their paths; from ancient times until the end of the age, they shall not pass beyond their command.
In that name, they shall cast away their paths of wickedness; they shall call upon their name, and they shall return unto Him from ancient times even unto the ages of ages.
Likewise, for the waters, their bodies are the spirits of life; all their members and their passages are of the spirits of the abyss.
In that place, the gathering of the word of the Lord and the brightness of the flame shall be preserved.
In that place, the gathering of the frost and the gathering of the dew, the gathering of the mist and the gathering of the rain shall be preserved.
All these shall believe and give thanks before the Lord of spirits; with all their might, they shall give thanks.
Always, their food is thanksgiving; they shall give thanks to the Lord of spirits who dwells forever; they shall honor Him; they shall exalt Him greatly.
This name shall be exalted upon them; in Him shall they be preserved; their paths shall be preserved; their passages shall not be lost.
Great joy shall be theirs; because the name of the Son of man has been revealed unto them, they shall give thanks; they shall honor Him; they shall exalt Him greatly.
In His majesty, He has sat upon the throne; and to the Son of man, the power of judgment has been given.
From the face of the earth, He shall cast away the wicked; He shall destroy them; and the world shall be shown in the assembly of the righteous.
Their community shall be consumed by destruction, and all their works shall not pass from the face of the earth.
From now on, there shall be no one who remains in hiding; for the Son of Man is revealed and seated upon His throne of glory. And all evil shall vanish from before Him.
And they shall go and speak to the Son of Man; before the Lord of spirits, they shall stand; this is the parable of Enoch.
And thereafter it shall be thus; before the Lord of spirits, the Son of Man shall be more exalted than all the men who dwell upon the earth.
And the spirits of the righteous shall be exalted; and His name shall go forth among them.
And from that day forth, I was not counted among them.
For the chosen and for the righteous, let the angels prepare a place for me, that I may dwell among them in the two heavens, in the midst of the east and the west.
And there, from ancient times, I beheld the place where the forefathers and the righteous dwell.
And after this, it came to pass that my heart began to tremble; it began to ascend above the heavens, and it began to go forth into the heavens.
The holy angels also stood upon the fire and looked upon the children. Their garments and their coverings were white; and their faces were as bright as snow.
I beheld two streams of fire; and that fire shone like a brilliant light, as a lamp; and I fell down before the Lord of spirits upon my face.

One of the chief angels, the angel Michael, took hold of my right hand and raised me up; he brought me forth to the place of mercy, and to the place of righteousness, which was called by the name of the Lord.
In the heavenly portal, I was shown all those who were summoned, both the hosts of stars and the gatherings of lights, as they came forth before the saints.
The spirit also carried Enoch above the heavens, and brought him to the heavenly abode.
And there, amidst the brightness, I beheld a house built of light, as if it were a shining abode.
And among those stones, there were living flames for the righteous.
My spirit beheld the fire that is honored around that house; and there were rivers filled with living fire at the four corners. That house was surrounded by them.
Seraphim and cherubim, and those who were around them, were present. These do not rest, but keep watch over the throne of His glory.
I beheld many, even countless, angels who could not be numbered; and that house was honored by them.
Michael and Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, the holy angels who are in heaven, entered and departed from that house.

ያም ብሉየ መዋዕል ከሚካኤልና ከገብርኤል፥ ከሩፋኤልና ከፋኑኤል፥ ቍጥር ከሌላቸው ብዙ፥ የብዙ ብዙ ከሚሆኑ መላእክትም ጋር መጣ።

እንዲህም አለኝ- “ለእውነት የተወለድህ የሰው ልጅ አንተ ነህ፤ ጽድቅም በአንተ አደረ፤ የብሉየ መዋዕል ቸርነትም አይለይህም።”
እንዲህም አለኝ- “ከጥንት ጀምሮ ሰላም በዚያ ተገኝትWaልና፥ ለዘለዓለም የሚሆን ሰላምን በስሙ ይጠራልሃል።
እንደዚሁም ለዓለም፥ ለዘለዓለም ይሆንልሃል፥ ሁሉም ይደረግልሃል፤ ጽድቅም ለዘለዓለም ሳይለይህ ሁሉ በመንገድህ ይሄዳል።
ማደሪያቸውም ከአንተ ጋር ይሆናል፥ ዕድል ፋንታቸውም ከአንተ ጋር ነው፤ ከአንተም ለዓለም ለዘለዓለም አይለዩም።
እንደዚህም ከዚያ የሰው ልጅ ጋር ብዙ ዘመን ይሆናል።
ለጻድቃንም ሰላም ይሆናል፤ መንገዱም በመናፍስት ጌታ ስም ለጻድቃን ለዘለዓለም የቀና ነው።”
የሰማይ ብርሃናትን መመላለስ የሚናገር መጽሐፍ።
እየአንዳንዳቸው በየወገናቸው እንደ አሉ፥ እየአንዳንዳቸውም በየሥልጣናቸውና በየዘመናቸው፥ እየአንዳንዳቸውም በየስማቸውና በየመውጫቸው፥ በየወራታቸውም ከእኔ ጋር ያለው መሪያቸው መልአክ ቅዱስ ዑርኤል እንደ አሳየኝ።

The sun shall rise from the heavens; it shall journey towards the east and return towards the west, and it shall enter through that window, guiding the way; even in the heavens, it shall shine forth.
Thus, in the first month, it shall emerge from the great window; the sun shall rise from the east through the sixth windows, and it shall emerge from the fourth.
In the first month, when the sun rises from her, at that time, in the fourth window, there shall be twelve openings from which it shall emerge.
When the sun rises from the east, in this fourth window, it shall shine for thirty days.
In the heavens, at the entrance, it shall descend through the fourth window.
And in those months, until the thirtieth day, the day shall diminish from the day; and the night shall increase from the night.
On this day, the day shall diminish by two hands from the night.
Even if it is pressed, the day shall be ten parts; and the night shall be eight parts.
The sun shall rise from this fourth window; and it shall enter through the fourth window.
The sun shall return towards the east and shall enter the fifth gate; from it shall it go forth, and it shall enter the fifth gate.
At that time, the day shall stretch with two hands; the day shall be as a part of eleven; the night shall be shortened; and it shall be as a part of seven.
The sun shall return towards the east; it shall enter the sixth gate; concerning her, there shall be a sign.
On that day, the day shall stretch longer than the night; the day shall be as a part of twelve; the day shall be shortened; and the night shall be as a part of six.
The day shall be shortened, and the night shall be lengthened; the sun shall rise.
The sun shall return towards the east; it shall enter the sixth window; from her, thirty days shall go forth; it shall also enter.
When the thirtieth day is completed, if it be measured carefully, the day shall lose one part; the day shall be as a part of eleven; the night shall be as a part of seven.

The sun shall rise from the sixth window in the west and shall go towards the east; the thirtieth day shall go forth from the fifth window; and it shall also enter from the west, from the fifth window.
On that day, the day shall be as a part of two; the day shall be as a part of ten; the night shall be as a part of eight.
The sun shall go forth from the fifth window; it shall enter from the west, from the fifth window.
Concerning her sign
On that day, the dawn shall be aligned with the night; it shall be as if they are intertwined; and the night shall be in nine parts. The dawn shall also be in nine parts.
The sun shall rise from this window.
In the third window, it shall rise on the fortieth day; and in the west, it shall enter through the third window.

On this day, the night shall extend from its night until the fortieth day; and the day shall extend from its day until the fortieth day. Even if it is counted with caution, the night shall be in ten parts; and the day shall be in eight parts.
The sun shall rise from this window and enter in the west through the third window, and it shall return to the east.
The sun shall rise in the east from the second window on the fortieth day.
Likewise, in the western sky, it shall enter through the second window; and on that day, the night shall be in eleven parts; and the day shall be in seven parts.
The sun shall rise on that day from this second window and enter in the west through the second window, and it shall return to the east.
The sun shall rise in the east from the first window as a sign.

On that day, the night shall be shorter than the day; and the night shall be as a twelfth part of the day; if it be measured carefully, the night shall be twelve parts; and the day shall be six parts.
The sun shall set its portals; and the second time shall it enter through these portals, thirty days shall it remain in that portal; and on the other side, it shall enter in the west.
On that day, the night shall be of a length of one hand; this is one part; the night shall be eleven parts; and the day shall be seven parts.
The sun shall return and shall enter through the second portal in the east; and there the portal shall return, and thirty days shall it go forth; it shall enter.
On that day, the night shall be of a length of one hand; the night shall be ten parts, and the day shall be eight parts.
On that day, the sun shall go forth from the second portal; and it shall set in the west and return to the east.
The sun shall enter through the third portal as a sign.
On that day, the night shall be shorter; it shall be nine parts; and the day shall also be nine parts.
The night shall be joined with the day; and the year, if it be measured carefully, shall be three hundred sixty-four days.
The length of the day and the night, and the measure of the day and the night shall be distinguished by the path of the sun.
Therefore, his path shall be illuminated; day shall call unto day, and night shall call unto night.
The order of the sun, and his path, and his circuit, this is it.
In the time of his return, he shall accomplish his course like a runner; he shall return and go forth; this is the great light that shall endure forever.
The Lord, as He has commanded, shall be called by Him, a great light that comes forth from the east.
Thus shall he go forth; he shall be fitting; he shall not be hindered; he shall not be turned aside; yet in the season and in the night, he shall run swiftly.
And the light shall shine brighter than the moon, sevenfold shall it illuminate.
The measure of both is equal.
After this order, I beheld another order, whose name is the moon, which gives light to the night.
And its brightness is as the brightness of heaven; and the wind carries it to the place where it goes.
And the light shall be given in measure.
And in every month, its going forth and its entrance shall be changed; and the day shall be as the day of the sun.
The condition of the moon, when it is perfected, shall be as the seventh hand of the sun.
Thus shall it go forth; and its waxing shall be in the thirtieth day, and it shall go forth towards the east.
And on that day it shall be seen; and for you it shall be a new moon.
On the thirtieth day, it shall wax, and on the twenty-first day, when the sun goes forth, it shall be in conjunction with the sun.
The seventh part of the light of the moon is one half of its light; and the part that is separated from the sun is the seventh part of the light of the moon, and all the board shall be void of light.
One seventh of the moon's light shall be as one seventh of its light on the day it is received.
It shall be joined with the sun; when the sun rises, the moon shall go forth with it; and it shall receive the hand of its brightness.
Before the day when the moon shall turn red, on that night the moon shall shine with the sun.
And on that night, the seventh and sixth hands, and its brightness shall be darkness; and on that day, the seventh hand shall completely be received and shall go forth.
And it shall be red as it departs from the sun, and on the remaining day, it shall shine brightly, receiving seven times seven hands.

በታወቁም ወራቶች መግቢያዎቹን ይለውጣል፤ በታወቁም ወራቶች አንድ አንድ ክፍለ ብርሃን እየተሰጠው መንገዱን ይሄዳል።
ጨረቃም በሕፀፁ በሁለቱ ከፀሐይ ጋር ይገባል፤ በመካከል ባሉ በእነዚያ በሁለቱ መስኮቶች በአራተኛዪቱና በሦስተኛዪቱ መስኮት ሰባት ቀን ይወጣል።
ዳግመኛም ዙሮ ተመልሶ ፀሐይ በሚወጣበት መስኮት ይወጣል፤ በዚያም መስኮት ብርሃኑን ሁሉ ፈጽሞ ያገኛል።
ከፀሐይም ይርቃል፤ ፀሐይ ከእርሷ በሚወጣባት በስድስተኛዪቱም መስኮት ስምንት ቀን ይገባል።
ፀሐይም ከአራተኛዪቱ መስኮት በሚወጣ ጊዜ ከአምስተኛዪቱ መስኮት እስኪወጣ ድረስ በአራተኛዪቱ መስኮት ሰባት ቀን ይወጣል።
And the moon shall return, and at the fourth window, it shall go forth for seven days; and it shall receive all the light.
It shall be darkened; and at the first window, it shall be for eight days; and the moon shall return, and when the sun goes forth from her, at the fourth window, it shall go forth for seven days.
In their seasons, as the sun goes forth and as it sets, I have seen their changes thus.
And in those months, it shall be added five years; and for the sun, it shall reach thirty days.
For one year, all the days shall reach; and from these, from the five years, the days shall be three hundred sixty-four days.
For the sun and for the stars, it shall reach six days; and from the five years, it shall reach thirty days.
And the moon shall be hidden from the sun and from the stars for thirty days.
And the moon shall keep watch over the years.
All shall remain as they are for eternity; one day shall not pass away; they shall not perish. However, three hundred sixty-four days shall be, and with care, they shall change the true year.
The day of three years is one thousand twenty-two; the day of eight years is two thousand twenty-nine hundred and twelve; and the day of five years is one thousand eight hundred twenty days.
To the moon alone shall it come; the day of the three years is six hundred and sixty-two days.
On the sixty-second day, as it rises above, it shall be added to the day of the sun, for the moon shall be diminished for the five years to fifty days.
For the moon, the day of the eight years shall be two thousand eight hundred thirty-two days, while the day of the five years shall be one thousand seven hundred seventy days.
In the eight years, the day that is counted is the eighth day, and from the eight years, the days that are diminished are eight days.
As they dwell, so shall the sun dwell; the measure of the time shall indeed be fulfilled in truth.
From the windows through which the stars emerge, the sun shall go forth for thirty days; it shall be fitting.

Over all creatures and over all the stars that are set, the rulers of the heavens shall reign, as the number of the days of the age shall be added to them and shall not be separated from their dwelling with the four stars.
These are the four days that shall not be counted in the number of the year.
In that age, they shall indeed possess the world of the stars, and people shall be nourished by them.
One at the first gate.
For a sign.
In this world, to be seen in the heavens, and upon the earth.
The sun and the moon, and the stars, all the celestial bodies that traverse the heavens, shall serve as rulers for the day and for the night.
Uriel in the heavens, as the sun revolves around them, showed me thus the twelve gates that emerge from the sun's feet.
In the ages that are known, at the time they are opened, there shall be a great outpouring upon the earth from them.

For the winds and for the breath that brings forth the tempest, at the time they are opened in the ages, upon the earth's border, I beheld in the heavens the sun and the moon, and the stars, all the heavenly creatures that emerge from the east and from the west, the twelve gates that are opened upon the earth's border, I beheld in the heavens.
There are many windows that are opened from the east and from the west.
As the Lord commanded them, as they go forth from the stars, according to their number, as they enter, so one of those windows shall contain the heat of its time.
I beheld the heavens as they flew, through those windows, and the serpents above and below them, for eternity.
One is all.
The winds that proceed from them and those that blow upon the earth, I beheld twelve gates opened for all the winds at the edge of the earth.
Of these, three are in the east, three are in the west, three are in the north, and three are in the south.
The first three are in the east, three are in the west, and behind, on the left side, I beheld three in the south, and three in the north.
From among them, four winds of blessing and peace shall come forth; and from these, eight winds of destruction shall emerge.
And these, when they are sent forth, shall cover the whole earth; and all that is upon it, the waters that are upon it, and all that dwell therein, shall be overwhelmed by them.

And from these gates, for the south, in the eastern direction, at its first gate, the first wind that is called the east wind shall come forth; and from it shall come the sound of the earth, destruction and calamity.
In the middle, at the second gate, righteousness shall come forth; and from it shall come rain, fruit, peace, and abundance.
In the west, at the third gate, shall come forth drought and destruction.
And after these winds, those that are in the south shall come forth first from the three gates.
From among them, for the east, at its first gate, shall come forth a wind of destruction.
She is positioned beside herself, and from her middle window, a good scent shall emanate, with fragrance and glory, peace and life shall flow forth.
To the west, she is positioned, and from her third window, a fragrance and glory shall emerge, with a sweet sound and harmony.

The name of the sea is called, and from the winds that are behind the three windows, for the fragrance that is offered in the east, from her seventh window, a fragrance and glory shall emerge, with a sweet sound and harmony.
From her central window, a glory and fragrance shall flow forth, with life and peace.
To the sea that is offered in the west, from her third window, a fragrance and sweetness shall emerge, with a sweet sound and glory, fragrance and harmony.
To the west, from these four winds, behind her first window that is offered to the sea, a fragrance and glory shall emerge, with the fragrance of the aged and the sweet smell, glory and delight.
From her central window, a fragrance and glory shall flow forth, with peace and blessing.
To the east, she is positioned, and from her second window, a fragrance and harmony shall emerge, with beauty and destruction.
The ten windows of the four heavenly realms were opened. My son, Matusal! I have shown you all their commands and all their offerings, and all their peace.
It is the beginning, and the first wind shall be called by its name, "Zebahawi."
In that place, the Most High
All the lights of heaven shall gather there, and they shall descend there; and the wind that blows from the west shall be called by them, "Godelo."

The wind known as "Mesih" shall be divided into four; of these, one is for the dwelling of man; the second is in the waters of the seas and in the rivers, in the trees and in the valleys, shrouded in darkness and gloom. The third part is enveloped in the garden of righteousness.
From the earth, I beheld all the mountains that tremble; I saw seven mighty mountains.
From them shall come forth the day, the age, and the year; they shall not pass away, but shall endure.
I beheld seven rivers that are greater than all the rivers upon the earth; and one of them came from the west and poured its waters into the great ocean.
And these two shall come forth from Mesih to the sea, and their waters shall flow towards the east into the sea of Eritrea.
And the remaining four shall flow to their sea until they reach the sea of Eritrea, flowing beside Mesih.
And the two rivers shall merge into the great sea; there they shall be gathered.
I beheld seven great islands in the sea and in the rivers; of these, two are in the rivers, and five are in the great sea.
The name of the sun is as follows; one is called Oryares, and the second is called Thomas.
For the moon, there are four names; one is called Asonya, the second is called Ebla, the third is called Benase, and the fourth is called Era.
These two are great lights; their glory is as the glory of heaven; their measures are equal.
In the sun, the seventh part of light is added to the moon, and the seventh part of the sun shall be received until it is completed.
They shall enter through the western window, and they shall turn towards the east, and they shall go forth before the face of heaven through the eastern window.
The moon shall be seen in the sky when it comes out; it shall also receive the seventh part of light equally.
On the fourteenth day, the light shall be completely received; the third part of the light shall also be added to it.
As a sign for the ages, until the fifteenth day, the light shall be completely received; it shall also be the third part; the moon shall be equal in one seventh hand.
In the time of the child, on the first day, it shall take the fourteenth hand of light; on the second day, it shall take the third hand.
On the third day, it shall take the second hand; on the fourth day, it shall take the first hand.
On the fifth day, let him take away the tenth part; and on the sixth day, let him take away the seventh part.
On the seventh day, let him take away the eighth part; and on the eighth day, let him take away the seventh part.
On the ninth day, let him take away the sixth part; and on the tenth day, let him take away the fifth part.
On the eleventh day, let him take away the fourth part; and on the twelfth day, let him take away the third part.
On the thirteenth day, let him take away the second part; and on the fourteenth day, let him take away the hand of the seventh part in equal measure.
On the fifteenth day, all the light that remains from the brightness shall be extinguished.
In the appointed months, on the twenty-seventh day, it shall be for the moon a sign; and on the twenty-eighth day, there shall be a time for a sign to be made.
The angel Uriel also showed me another ordinance at the time when the moon is in conjunction with the sun.

From the day when the moon begins to receive light from the sun, throughout all the time it goes, its brightness shall be before the sun; until the fourteenth day, its brightness shall be manifested in the heavens.
All things.
The sun, as it sets in the west, shall withdraw its light with caution; and at night, it shall rise from the east.
The sun shall illuminate the night until the moon rises; and the moon shall be eclipsed before the face of the sun.
From the moment the light of the moon departs, all its brightness shall remain until it is extinguished; thereafter, it shall be darkened.
The moon shall not shine for the month that passes, and the sky shall be void of light.

In the third month, when it shall be observed, on the thirtieth day, it shall bring forth the new moon. And on the days when the three months are observed, on the fifteenth day, it shall bring forth the new moon.

In the first age, on the first window, on the seventh day of the hundred, during the time of the birth, the three months shall be seen on every thirtieth day. And the three months shall be seen on the fifteenth day.
Without the sun, there is no other light; and on the fifteenth day, it shall be seen as a man at night, and by day, it shall be seen as the heavens.
Now, my son, behold, I have shown you all; all the ordinances of the heavenly bodies have been established.
In every day and in every season, in every year, in all their cycles, in every month and in all their gatherings, I have shown you the ordinances concerning these.
In this sixth window, the light shall be extinguished, and in the sixth window, the new moon shall be shown to me.
And thereafter, there shall be the month of the moon; and in the time when it is made to shine, I was shown a child at the first window of its beginning.
Until the hundred and seven days are completed, if they are counted according to their order, it shall be twenty-five days from the second day.
The moon, in one year, shall be counted carefully according to the order of the sun and the stars, and if it is counted carefully, it shall be five days.
This is what you shall see: at the time of its completion, its leader, the great angel Uriel, showed me a light that surpasses all brightness, and you shall see such a vision and parable.
And in that time, the angel Uriel said to me, "Behold, I have shown you all things."
When you see this sun and this moon, and the stars of heaven that are related to them,
their works and their times, and all that shall change their going forth, I have made it clear to you.
In the days of iniquity, the frost shall come; and in their fields and in their harvest, their unfruitfulness shall reach them.
All work that is upon the earth shall be cast away, and in its time it shall not be seen; and the heavens shall be troubled, and the rain shall cease from the heavens.
In those days, the fruit of the earth shall be barren, and in its time it shall not yield; and the fruit of the trees shall be withheld from their season.
The moon also shall change its order, and in its time it shall not shine.
In those days, the heavens shall be opened, and the clouds shall be seen in the west, and they shall bring forth great rain; and the heavens shall shine more than the brightness of the sun.
Many shall be led astray by the rulers of the stars; and they shall change their paths and their works, and in the days of their command, they shall not be seen.
The order of the stars shall be changed upon the sinners, and upon the inhabitants of the earth, their understanding shall be altered.
They shall be led astray from all their paths, and they shall be deceived, and the angels shall be made to deceive them.
Their troubles shall increase, and all that is to be destroyed shall come upon them.

Thus I spoke: "Enoch, behold the book that is written in the heavens; read what is written therein. Examine each one and understand." I looked upon the book that is written in the heavens; I read all that was written therein, and I understood everything.
I have read the book, and I have considered all the works of men that are written therein; I have seen all that is born of flesh upon the earth, even unto the end of the world.
And after this, I shall give thanks to the Lord, the great King of eternal glory, for all the works of the world that He has done.
Concerning His patience, I will honor the Lord; I will give thanks, for I have been mindful of the children of Adam.

And I said thus: “The righteous and the merciful shall not die; all the letters of wickedness shall not be written against him, and on the day of judgment, the man who has not been found guilty of sin is indeed righteous.”
And these three are the holy ones.

And they said to me: “For your son, let all these things be spoken; before the Lord, every carnal man is as one who does not justify; teach your children this clearly, for He has created them quickly.”
Teach your children, and write for them, and for all your children, be a guide until they are grown, for one year let us be diligent with your children.
In the second year, however, among them shall be taken; for the goats teach truth to the goats, and your heart shall be strengthened.
The righteous shall rejoice with the righteous, and they shall greet one another in peace; the wicked shall perish with the wicked, and he who returns to sin shall be given to sin.
And those who do righteousness shall perish in the works of the wicked, and concerning the works of the wicked, they shall be gathered.
In those days, they ceased to speak with me, and I returned to my times, giving thanks to the Lord of the worlds.
Now, my son Matusal, I shall speak to you concerning all these things; I shall write for you, and I shall make all things clear to you; I have delivered to you the writings of all these.
My son Matusal, keep the writings of your father, that they may be passed down to the generations of the world.
To you and to your children, I have given wisdom; this wisdom shall endure in their hearts, even to their children’s children, until the end of the world.
This wisdom shall be cherished by those who understand it, and those who heed it shall not be forsaken; rather, they shall be more in harmony than those who consume the food of the gluttonous.
All the righteous are pure; they walk in the path of righteousness, and in all their generations, they are pure, for they are without sin as the mighty.
The sun that travels in the heavens shall shine with the stars, and it shall be fitting for thirty days, and it shall go forth.
This is the order of the stars, which shall be observed by those who dwell in the four divisions of time and by the four who are called the stars.
With them, there shall be four days; concerning them, men shall be confounded; in all the world, their number shall not be counted, for they shall be hidden.
Men shall not perceive them clearly; their number is known in their time, for they are truly inscribed for eternity.
One shall be at the first window, one at the third window, one at the fourth window, and one at the sixth window shall be fitting.
The year shall be completed in three hundred sixty-four days; indeed, it is the truth, and the number written is confirmed.

All the creation of the world, the Lord commanded His heavenly host, the angel Uriel, concerning the lights and the months, concerning the festivals, concerning the four divisions of the ages and years, and He showed me the days; and He imparted knowledge unto me.
And He has authority over the sun and the moon, and the stars, and all the heavenly hosts that are in their courses, to show forth light by day and by night.
In their places and in their seasons, according to their ordinances and their months, the order of the stars that go forth and enter is this.

The stars that keep their appointed times, this is their name; in their seasons and in their ordinances, in their times and in their months, they shall be accounted according to their dominions and their stations.
The four leaders that are called the four divisions of the year shall be accounted for beforehand.

And from them shall follow the thirtieth day and three hundred sixty-four days that shall be accounted for, the stars that are called the ordinances of the year, the twelve months of the year, the seven days, and the four divisions of the ages shall be accounted for according to the ten leaders.
And these are the leaders of the ten, among the chief and the subordinate; one shall be added to another in their stations; and their leaders shall account for the thirtieth day.
The four divisions of the ages that are called the appointed times of these leaders.
The names of the monthly leaders that are appointed for the ten are Andriel, Iesusael, and Iylumael.
