ከእነርሱ ጋር የሚጨመር ሌላው የሻለቃ ስሙ ሄሉያሴፍ ነው።
የዚህ የምልክኤል የምግብናው ወራት ተፈጸመ፤ ከእርሱም ቀጥሎ ሁለተኛው መጋቢ ስሙን ብሩህ ፀሐይ ብለው የሚጠሩት ሕልመልመሌክ ነው።
የሚያበራበትም ቀን ሁሉ ዘጠና አንድ ቀን ነው፤ በምድር ላይ የሚመግብባቸው ወራቶች ምልክቶች ሙቀትና ድርቅ ናቸው።
The trees also shall bring forth their fruit in due season; they shall give their ripe fruit; and the goats shall gather themselves together, and they shall be fruitful.
The people shall gather all the fruits of the earth, and all the fruits that are in the field, and all the fruits that are in the vineyard; this shall be done in the season of harvest.
Their names and their ordinances are these; those who serve in their daily offices are called Gidāel and Kiēl, and they are Heēl.
And with them shall be added the chief of the thousand, whose name is Asphāel; and the season of harvest was accomplished.
My son, I have revealed to you all the visions that I have seen today; and I shall speak of this before you.
I beheld two visions without my wife; and one of them was not like the other.
The first vision I saw while I was reading the book; and the second, I beheld a strong vision without your mother.
Concerning these matters, I sought the Lord; while I was lying in my grandmother's house, I saw in a vision as the heavens fell and trembled, and I beheld it fall upon the earth.
Upon the earth, at the time it fell, I saw the earth being given as a great burden.
As the mountains trembled upon the mountains, and the hills upon the hills, and the great trees were uprooted from their roots, I beheld them being cast down by a great flood.
And from him arose a matter in my mind, and I began to cry out, saying, "The earth is lost!"
My grandmother, while I was lying in him, awakened me, saying, "My son, why do you cry out like this? Why do you tremble like this?"
And I declared to her all that I had seen.

And he said to me, "My son, you have seen how you are strengthened in your mind; all that is lost upon the earth is shown to you in a dream; for the earth shall not be given to the flood, and it shall perish in a great destruction."
Now, my son, thou art he who hast believed, and upon the earth let there be a cry that it may be heard, and let the earth not be destroyed; arise and call upon the Lord of glory.
My son, all this shall descend from heaven and shall be upon the earth; and upon the earth, it shall be a mighty destruction.
After this, I arose and prayed, saying: "For my sake, may my prayer be written for my son, that it may endure for generations."
My son, behold! I have shown thee all things; I have lifted my face, and in my going forth, I beheld heaven, and I saw the sun as it rose in the east.
I beheld the moon as it set in the west; I saw the stars of the little ones and all the earth diminished; I knew all things, and at the beginning, I gave thanks to the Lord, the Judge.
From the east, I brought forth the sun and offered praise unto Thee; the sun arose and shone upon the heavens, and it arose and walked upon the path that was seen.
Truly, I lifted my hands high; I gave thanks unto the Holy One and the Righteous.
God spoke unto man, saying: "By His breath, He created man, and by His flesh, He spoke unto him; He spoke unto him by His breath, and gave unto him the spirit and the flesh."
O Lord, Thou art blessed; King, Righteous One, Mighty One; in Thy righteousness, all creation of heaven is Thy Lord; Thou art the King of kings and the God of all the world.
Thy dominion and Thy kingdom shall endure forever; Thy power is for all generations.
The heavens are all Your dwelling place forever; the earth is the footstool of Your feet for eternity.

You have created all things, and You possess all things; even one work shall not be lacking to You; nor shall any wisdom be hidden from You; Your throne shall not depart from its place, nor shall You depart from Your sea.
You know all things, You see all things, You hear all things, and there is nothing that is hidden from You.
Now, behold, Your angels of heaven.
Now, O God, Lord and King, I beseech You to remember me, a son of man upon the earth, that You may hear my prayer.
Do not destroy all mankind, nor leave the earth desolate; let there be no destruction forever.
Now, my Lord, I beseech You to remove from the earth the body that has grieved You.
Sustain the body of righteousness and truth for eternity. O Lord, do not turn away my prayer from before You, nor from me, Your servant.
After this, I beheld another dream, my son, I showed thee all things.
And Enoch said unto his son Methuselah, “Hearken unto my words, my son;
To hear my dream and thy father's dream, prepare thine ears; for I beheld a vision in my sleep, before thy mother conceived.
Behold, a heifer went forth from the earth, and she was white; and after her came forth a female goat.
And two kids came forth from her; one of them was black, and the other was red; and the black kid attacked the red kid, and they were followed upon the earth.
From that time forth, I was not able to see that red kid, for that black kid was fierce.
And with him came that female goat. I beheld many lambs that went forth with him, and they followed him.
And this first female was a heifer, and she went forth before the first one.
And that red kid desired her, but she found him not; and at that time she cried out with a great cry and desired him.
And that first one did not come unto her until she had cried out; and after that time, she did not cry out again.
ከዚህም በኋላ ሌላ ነጭ ላምን ወለደች፥ ከእርሱም ቀጥሎ ብዙ ላሞችንና ጥቋቁር ጊደሮችን ወለደች።
በመኝታዬም ነጭ በሬን አየሁ፥ እንደዚህም አደገ፥ ታላቅ ነጭ በሬም ሆነ፥ ከእርሱም ብዙ ነጫጭ ላሞች ተወለዱ፥ በመልክም ይመስሉታል።
ብዙ ነጫጭና የሚመስሏቸውን ላሞችንም ይወልዱ ጀመር፥ አንዱም ሌላውን ተከተለው።
ዳግመኛም ተኝቼ በዐይኖቼ አየሁ፥ ወደ ላይም ሰማይን ተመለከትሁ።
እነሆ፥ ከሰማይ አንድ ኮከብ ወደቀ፤ ከፍ ከፍም ይላል፥ ይበላልም፥ በእነዚያም ላሞች መካከል ይሰማራል።
ከዚያም በኋላ ታላላቆችንና ጥቋቁር ላሞችን አየሁ፥ እነሆ፥ ሁሉም መመሰጊያቸውንና መሰምሪያቸውን፥ ጥጆቻቸውንም ለወጡ፤ አያንዳንዳቸውም ከሌላው ጋር ይጮሁ ጀመሩ፥
ዳግመኛም ራእይ አየሁ፥ ሰማይንም ተመለከትሁ።
እነሆ፥ ብዙ ከዋክብትንም አየሁ፥ ከሰማይም ወደዚያ ወደ መጀመሪያው ኮከብ ወርደው ወደቁ፥ በእነዚያም ጥጆች መካከል ላሞች ሆኑ።
ከእነርሱም ጋር በመካከላቸው የሚሰማሩ ሆኑ፥ እነርሱንም ፈጽሜ አየኋቸው።
እነሆ፥ ሁሉም እንደ ፈረሶች ኀፍረታቸውን አውጥተው በላሞች ጊደሮች ላይ ይንጠላጠሉ ጀመሩ።
All creatures that creep and crawl, and the beasts of the field, and the birds of the air, they were afraid of them; and from before them, they fled in terror.
As they were being pursued, they cried out and fled; and they began to run away from their pursuers; thereafter, they began to be devoured by those beasts.
Behold, all the children of the earth, having risen from before them, they trembled and fled, and they began to run away from them.
And the one who was a hunter, when he pursued another, I beheld another fleeing.
And the earth began to cry out, and I lifted my eyes to heaven and beheld in vision.
Behold, they came forth from heaven, resembling men of stature; one departed from that place; and three went forth with him.
And those three who went forth with him seized my hand, and the men who were upon the earth were separated from me.
And upon a high mountain they showed me a wall that was raised above the earth, and the foundation thereof was lower than it all.
Thus they spoke unto me, saying, “Upon those beasts and upon the goats, upon the stars, and upon all the fowl of the air, let all that is to come remain until this is established.”
Before they departed, I beheld one of the four, and from heaven there fell the first star that had descended.
And he stretched forth his hand and seized me with his mighty grasp; and that abyss was deep and dark, and it was filled with terror and gloom.
And one of them drew forth his sword for those beasts, for those goats and for the fowl.
And one began to pursue another, and the whole earth was stirred up because of them.
And it came to pass, when I beheld, that one of the four that had come forth, behold, he cast down the measure from heaven.
Their strength was as the strength of horses, and they gathered all the great beasts and took them.
They laid their hands and their feet upon the earth, and they cast them into the pit.
And one of the four went unto the lamb, running, and he taught the secret.
And the lamb was born; and he became a man, and he built the ship and sat therein.
And the three lambs sat with him in that ship, and the ship was prepared upon them.
And I lifted up mine eyes to heaven, and I saw a high firmament; and in it were seven fountains of water; and these fountains caused much water to flow in one place.
And I beheld, and lo, upon the earth, in that great place, the fountains were opened.
And the water began to flow and rise upon the earth; and the earth was not seen until it was covered with water.
And above all, the water was deep; it was darkness and gloom; and I beheld the height of that water, and it was high above that place.
And upon the place, the waters were being gathered, and upon the earth, they were restrained.
And in that place, all the creatures were given unto the waters; they swam and perished until they were gathered unto them.
That vessel was floating upon the waters, the creatures and the beasts, the cattle and the fowl, all were given unto the earth.
And I was not able to see them; they also went forth, and in the great sea they were given and perished.
And I beheld these creatures until they perished from the great abyss, and the source of the earth was broken.
Other channels were opened, and the earth was revealed until the waters began to descend upon them.
And that vessel was settled upon the earth. The darkness was distant, and there was light.
And a man, being a white dove, went forth from the vessel, and three creatures went forth with him.
Of these three creatures, one was a white dove, and it appeared like them; and one of them was red like blood; and one was black; and that white dove was separated from them and died.
The wild beasts of the wilderness and the birds also began to bring forth; and from them, every kind of creature was found among the nations.
Lions and birds, leopards and dogs, jackals and the wild goat, the gazelles and the hyenas,
The antelope and the gazelle, the wild goat and the ibex, the wild ox and the deer.
And among them was born a white lamb; and one began to butt against the other.
Among them was born that white lamb, even the wild ass of the plain; and with him was born a white lamb.
The wild asses of the plain were many; and from him was born that lamb—a black wild goat and a white one were born.
And that wild goat brought forth many kids; and in the fold, he brought forth twelve kids.
When the twelve kids were in the fold, one of them was given to the wild asses of the plain.
And those wild asses of the plain were given that kid to the leopards a second time. In the fold, it was dangerous among the leopards.
And the Lord commanded that one of the kids should dwell with him, and that he should be heard among the leopards; and he brought them forth.
And these were in the midst; many were the shepherds, and the wolves began to terrify them until they consumed their children and caused them great distress.
They cried out concerning their children with much water and lamentation; and those shepherds cried out for their children, and they began to lift their voices unto their Lord.
And the wolf, having been driven away, fled towards the field of the beasts.

And the Lord of the shepherds heard the voice of the shepherds, and until he descended from the heights of the heavens, he saw them crying out for the shepherds, and he beheld them in their complete strength as they called upon their Lord.
And he came unto them; he called that wolf which had been driven away; and he spoke concerning the wolves, that they should not harm the shepherds.
In the spirit of the Lord, he went unto the wolves; the other one joined with that wolf; and he went with him.
Both of them entered into the assembly of the wolves; and they spoke unto them.
And thus, let them not harm the shepherds.
After this, in their complete strength, they saw the wolves as if they were devouring them.
And the shepherds cried out; and their Lord came unto the shepherds and began to smite the wolves.
ዥቦችም ይጮሁ ጀመሩ፤ በጎቹም ዝም አሉ፤ ከዚያም ጊዜ ጀምሮ አልጮሁም፤ በጎችንም ከዥቦች ተለይተው እስኪወጡ ድረስ አየኋቸው።
የዥቦችም ዐይኖቻቸው ተጋረዱ። እነዚያም ዥቦች በፍጹም ኀይላቸው በጎችን እየተከተሉ ወጡ።
የበጎችም ጌታ እየመራቸው ከእነርሱ ጋር ሄደ፤ በጎችም ሁሉ እርሱን ተከተሉት፤ ፊቱም የበራና የከበረ ነው፤ መልኩም የሚያስፈራ ነው።
ዥቦች ግን በአንዲት የውኃ መጠራቀሚያ እስኪገናኙአቸው ድረስ በጎቹን ይከተሏቸው ጀመሩ።
ያም የውኃ መጠራቀሚያ ተከፈለ፤ ውኃውም በዚህና በዚያ በፊታቸው ቆመ፤ የበጎቹም ጌታ ይመራቸው ነበር፤ በመካከላቸውና በዥቦቹም መካከል ቆመ።
ዥቦቹም በጎቹን ገና አላዩአቸውም ነበር፤ በውኃው ማጠራቀሚያ መካከልም ሄዱ።
ዥቦችም በጎችን ተከተሏቸው፤ ዥቦቹም በውኃው መጠራቀሚያ ላይ ተከትለዋቸው ሮጡ።
የበጎቹንም ጌታ ባዩት ጊዜ ከፊቱ ይሸሹ ዘንድ ተመለሱ።
ያም የውኃው መጠራቀሚያ ተሰበሰበ፤ ፈጥኖም እንደ ቀድሞ ፍጥረቱ ሆነ፤ ውኃውም- እኒህን ዥቦች እስኪአሰጥማቸው ድረስ መልቶ ከፍ ከፍ አለ።
በጎቹንም የተከተሏቸው ዥቦች ሁሉ እስኪጠፉና እስኪሰጥሙ ድረስ አየሁ።
The sheep, however, passed through the water; they went into the wilderness where there was neither grass nor water.
Their eyes were opened, and they began to see; and their Lord, while He was watching over them and providing grass and water, they did not perceive.
That sheep was leading them before them; it went forth, and the head of the flock ascended to the heights.
And the Lord of the sheep sent forth to them; and I beheld the Lord of the sheep standing before them.
His form was beautiful and fearful; and all the sheep were afraid and did not gaze upon Him, for they were terrified at His presence.
And all of them were afraid and trembled at Him; and among them was one sheep that was different from the others, and it cried out to the second sheep that was with it.
They said, "We cannot stand before our Lord, nor can we behold Him;" and the sheep that was leading them turned back and went up to the heights.
And the sheep began to gaze upon their eyes; and when they saw Him, they began to follow the way.
That sheep was unknown; but the Lord of the sheep was greatly angered against them.
And the head of the flock descended from the heights.
And he came unto the sheep; and their eyes were dimmed, and he found most of them strayed from the way.
And when they saw him, they were afraid; and they rose up from before him and fled to their place.
And he led the sheep with others, and he entered into those that were lost.
And after this, he began to slay them; and the sheep were afraid from before him; and they returned to those that were lost; and they turned back to their places.
And there, until a man became, he worked for the house of the Lord of the sheep; and until he had gathered all the sheep in that house, I beheld the vision.
And I saw that one sheep which was leading them, that sheep which was joined with the other sheep, until it became a great sheep.
And I saw until all the great sheep perished; and among them, the little ones arose and entered into the fold.
And they drew near unto the water of the fountain; and that which was leading them, the man, that sheep separated from them and lay down.
And all the sheep cried out; and upon him they raised a great cry; and until that sheep which cried out was silenced, I beheld.
And that water of the fountain did not fail them; and concerning their thirst, the sheep were filled and they lay down.
And the goats went to the place of the wild, and to the land that was beloved, and to the land of the seven, until they entered, I did not see.
And those goats, until they were gathered, I did not see; that house was to dwell among them in the beloved land.
Another goat arose, until it led them, and their eyes were opened to see and to be amazed.
They all returned; their eyes were opened.
The wild goat arose until it stood; those goats were surrounded by dogs and wolves, and the wild beast began to attack them. And the one that led them was one of the wild.
That wild goat, until it destroyed them all, began to chase those dogs and wolves, and the wild beast would go here and there.
And the eyes of that goat were opened; among the goats, it saw the one that had fallen from its glory.
And those goats began to chase and scatter them; and he was without joy.
And the Lord of the goats sent the goat to another goat; and having cast down its glory, it became a wild goat, and it was raised to lead the goats.
And he went to him and spoke only to him; and that wild goat arose and became the leader and chief of the goats.
And in all this, those dogs were troubling the goats.
The first wild beast attacked the last wild beast; and the last wild beast arose and fled from his face.
And I beheld until the first wild beasts had devoured the last one.
Thus it came to pass that the last wild beast arose and led the little goats.
And the last wild beast bore many goats and died.
And the little one became a wild beast in him; and he became a lord and leader to those goats.
And those goats were in danger; they were in distress. And those were dogs and wolves, and the wild beasts feared him; and they fled from him.
And that wild beast devoured all the creatures; and the creatures could not enter among the goats. And from them, nothing was left.
And his house was great and spacious; and for those goats, a door was made upon that house. And for the goats, a long and great door was made upon that house.
And that house was built; its door was high and long; and the lord of the goats stood upon that door; and a full altar was set before him.
And the shepherd beheld them as sheep, and they wandered in many paths; he also forsook their dwelling.
And the Lord of the sheep, having departed from among the sheep, sent them unto the sheep; and the sheep began to be slain.
And one of them was delivered from death; he was not slain; and he ran swiftly and cried out upon the sheep.
And they desired to slay them; but the Lord of the sheep delivered them from the hand of the sheep, and brought them forth unto me and made them to dwell.
And when he cried out, they hearkened unto him, and many other sheep were sent unto those sheep.
And from among them arose the Lord of the sheep, and I beheld his house and his tower as they were forsaken; and from all these things their eyes were blinded.
And the Lord of the sheep had made much slaughter among them, and I beheld until the slaughter of those sheep was complete.

And they gave them their place; and he laid his hand upon the lions and the birds, upon the wild beasts and the serpents, upon the cattle and the beasts of the field; and those wild creatures began to devour the sheep.
And he beheld their house and their tower as they were forsaken.
And they began to devour them from the hand of the lions, and they were slain by every wild beast; all their hands were upon them.
And I, with all my strength, shall call upon Thee, O Lord of the righteous, and I have begun to speak concerning the righteous; for all the beasts of the forest have been made silent.
And He, having seen, was silent; He rejoiced; for they have been made silent, and their possessions have been taken away; that they may become food for all the beasts, He has laid His hand upon them.
He called the shepherds; and they shall keep watch over them, as He gave them to those good ones.
To the shepherds and their servants, He said thus: “Let each of you from this day forth keep watch over the good ones; and I shall do all that you ask of me.”
“I too shall give you in number; and concerning those who are lost, I will speak to you; and cast them away,” and He gave them to those good ones.
And calling another, He said, “If they are commanded and depart, they shall perish among them; therefore, be mindful of all that the shepherds do concerning these good ones; take heed.”
As for how many shall perish by my command, and how many shall perish by their own, write down all the violence and destruction that is done to the shepherds.
Write down all the destruction of each of their shepherds upon them. And before me, read in number; as much as they have perished, so shall it be given to them for destruction.
That I may know all the work of the shepherds, this shall be my witness.
When they are commanded, let them remain steadfast, or if they do not remain, let it be as they do; I shall not see what they do to give them.
They shall not know; and you shall not show them; do not let them be troubled; but at every time, write down the destruction of the shepherds as they perish. Bring all to me.
And those shepherds I saw until they kept watch over them; and from those who were commanded, many departed and began to perish.
And they were led by the hands of the goats and the lions; and the lions and the birds devoured many of those goats.
The wild beasts also were with them; they tore that wall down; and they broke into the house of the goats.
And I, for that house of the goats is broken down, I lament greatly concerning the wall.
And thereafter, whether they entered that house or not, I was not able to see those goats.
And their servants and their attendants were to slay the goats, so they gave them to all the wild beasts of the forest.

And each one of them received according to his number at every time; and whatever each one of them would destroy, it was written down for the second in the book; rather, having departed from their order, each one would slay; and it would destroy.
And concerning those goats, I have often lamented and I have begun to cry.
Thus, daily, I saw how it was written for one of those servants who would destroy.
And he has drawn it out; for the Lord of the goats, all the book and all the work they do, and each one of them, what they have given and what they have offered for destruction, he will show all.
And the book was opened before the Lord of the goats; and he took the book in his hand; he read it; and he turned and he rested.
And after that, I beheld, the servants were keeping watch for twelve hours; and of those, three of the good ones returned and entered.
Then they began to do all that was commanded from the house; and the wild beasts were troubling them; yet they could not prevail against them.
The servants also began to do as before; they lifted the gate; but the gate was said to be long.
And while the servants were at the gate, they were preparing the pure and unblemished offerings; I beheld all the sacrifices being made upon him.
And upon all this, the good ones had closed their eyes; they could not see; and their servants were likewise.
For destruction, they shall be given over; and the good ones shall be trampled underfoot; they shall be cast down.
The Lord of the good ones remained silent until the good ones were gathered; and they were one with them; nor did He deliver them from the hand of the beasts.
And he who writes this book brought it forth; and the dwelling of the Lord of the good ones was established; concerning them, it shall be remembered.
And he showed all the work of the servants; they shall be judged; and before all the servants, he shall be their judge; and taking that book, he went forth from him.
And I beheld, thirty-seven servants, until the time they were to keep watch.
ሁሉም በየጊዜያቸው እንደ ቀድሞዎቹ ፈጸሙ።
ሌሎችም በየጊዜያቸው ይጠብቋቸው ዘንድ ከእጃቸው ተቀበሏቸው፤ እያንዳንዱም እረኛ ሁሉ በየጊዜው ነው።
ከዚህም በኋላ የሰማይ ወፎችን ሁሉ በራእይ አየሁ፥ ንስሮችና ጥንብ አሞራ፥ አንጭት አሞራና ቍራዎች መጡ። ንስሮችም ወፎችን ሁሉ ይመሯቸው ነበሩ።
እነዚያንም በጎች ይበሏቸው ጀመሩ፤ ዐይኖቻቸውንም ይጐጠጕጧቸው ጀመሩ፤ ሥጋቸውንም ይበሉአቸው ጀመሩ።
በጎችም ሥጋቸው በወፎች ተበልቶአልና ጮኹ።
እኔም ተኝቼ ሳለሁ ጮኽሁ፤ በጎችንም በሚጠብቃቸው በእረኛው ላይ አለቀስሁ።
በጎችም በውሾችና በንስሮች፥ በአንጭት አሞራዎችም እስከ ተበሉ ድረስ አየሁ።
አጥንቶቻቸው ብቻቸውን እስከ ቆሙ ድረስ ሥጋንና ቍርበትን፥ ጅማትንም ፈጽሞ አልተዉላቸውም፤ አጥንቶቻቸውም በምድር ላይ ወደቁ፤ በጎችም አነሱ።
ሃያ ሦስቱም እረኞች እስከሚጠብቁበት ዘመን ድረስ አየሁ፤ አምሳ ስምንት ሱባኤንም በየዘመናቸው ፈጸሙ።
ታናናሾች ጠቦቶችም ከእነዚያ ነጫጭ በጎች ተወለዱ፤ ዐይኖቻቸውንም ይገልጡና ያዩ፥ ወደ በጎችም ይጮኹ ጀመሩ።
And they did not cry out for the goats; nor did they bring forth the matter that was concerning them; but indeed they were troubled, and their eyes were covered, and they were oppressed.
And I beheld, as they were being scattered upon the mountains, I saw the cries; and one of those mountains they seized.
And they followed the goats closely; and I beheld until those mountains fell upon them. The cries were gathering their mountains unto them.
And among those goats, upon one of them, I beheld a great mountain until it was lifted up. Their eyes were opened.
And they beheld them; and their eyes were opened; and they cried out for the goats; and the mountains saw them; and all ran unto him.
The beasts and the ancient ones, the cries and the young ones, until this day they have been scattered. And upon them they were being gathered.
But the goats were silent; and the mountains cried out in haste; and those cries were mingling with them and were being lifted up. They desired to cast down the mountain, but they could not.
The shepherds, the beasts, and those ancient ones, even the young ones, until they came, I beheld them.
And they gathered that mountain to cry out for the cries.
And they were mingled with him and were lifted up; and he was lifted up with them; and the cry was that it may come unto you.
The names of the slain shall be written, and before the Lord of the righteous, that man shall not be seen until he comes.
And He helped them; He showed them all; and the great helper descended; and the Lord of the righteous did not appear to them until the appointed time came.
And all that they saw fled; all rose up from before Him and fell into despair. The beasts, the creeping things, and the birds, even the smallest of the creeping things gathered together.
And they brought forth the righteous from among them; all were united to gather on that great day.
The man who writes the book of the Lord's word shall not be seen until those twelve righteous ones who rose up behind him have revealed that book of destruction.
And they were shown before the Lord of the righteous, that they might not perish, as they were gathered before Him until the Lord of the righteous came to them.

And with the sword of His anger in His hand, He struck the earth; and the earth was shaken; and all the beasts, and all the birds of heaven fled from before them; and they were given to the earth; and the earth was burdened by them.
Until a great sword was given to the righteous, they were not seen; and the righteous were to be slain by all the beasts of the wilderness.
And the beasts and all the birds of heaven fled from before them.
In the land of the wicked, until the heavens were created, I beheld; and the Lord of the righteous was seated upon him.
And all the garments of the cleansed were lifted; and those garments were revealed before the Lord of the righteous.
And they called upon the seven stars that had gone before; and their brightness, as the brightness of a horse, was commanded to return to him from the first star unto him.
Previously, the first star that had fallen, all returned unto him.
And one of those seven stars, which was before him, spoke, saying,
"Those whom you have given to the righteous, if they have accepted and obeyed you, let them take these seven servants who have caused many to be cleansed."
Behold, they were all gathered before him; and all stood before him; and judgment began from the stars; they were cast out; and the sinners were found, and they went to the place of punishment.
And they turned to the great pit; that place is a place of burning, surrounded by fire and the flame of fire.
And those seven servants were brought for judgment; and they were sinners; and they were cast into that place of fire.
And at that time, I beheld a pit filled with fire, as it was opened in the midst of the earth.
Those who are remembered brought forth the goats. They were brought forth for judgment; and the sinners were found, and they were cast into the pit of fire; they were consumed.
That pit was on the right side of the house; and as those goats were consumed, I beheld their bodies being consumed.
That which was ruined shall not stand until I have avenged it; and all the sacrifices were cast out.
And that house was desolate, and all the goats were associated with him; and they were cast out and thrown into one place on the right side of the earth.
The Lord of the goats did not allow me to see until He brought forth a great and high new house from that which was before; and it was established in the place of that which was desolate.
Their sacrifices are all new; and their offerings are all new; for it is greater than that which was before, from the beginning; and all the goats are in the midst of it.
And all the remaining goats and all the beasts upon the earth, and all the birds of the heavens,
When those goats were slaughtered and offered, and as they were being consumed and all their words were being heard, I beheld them.
Then afterwards, they clothed me in white garments and took me up to heaven; those three took hold of my hand.
While that great hand was holding me, they took me out; and without judgment, they allowed me to dwell among those goats.
And they were all white as sheep; their wool was great and pure.
All that were lost and all that were injured, all the beasts of the field and all the birds of heaven were gathered in that house.
For all were gathered together, and they returned to their dwelling, and the Lord of the sheep was greatly pleased.
As for the sword that was given to the sheep, I did not see it until they had been slaughtered; and they returned to their home; and they bowed before the Lord.
And all the sheep were gathered in that house; but they were not able to see; for all their eyes were directed toward the sheep, and there was not one among them that did not see.
And I saw that house was great and wide; indeed, it was completely full. I saw one white lamb born; and the rams were great.
And all the beasts of the field and the birds of heaven fled, and they were born in their time.
And all their generations I saw until they had passed away; and all the lambs were white.
In the beginning, it was in the midst of them; and that thing was a great beast; and there were great and terrible rams upon it.
And the Lord of the sheep was pleased with them and with all the lambs.

And I, having lain down among them, awoke; I beheld all things; and the vision which I saw in my sleep was this: I awoke and gave thanks to the Lord of righteousness; and unto Him I offered my praise.
From Him arose a great lamentation; and when I beheld them descending, I could not prevail against my grief, and my tears did not cease.
All things shall come to an end; and every work of man shall be made manifest according to its kind.
And in that night I remembered the dream which had gone before; for I could not attain unto that vision, therefore I lamented concerning it; I also prayed.
Now, my son, Mattusala! Call all your brethren unto me; and gather together all the children of your mother; for the word hath called me.
Even unto eternity shall I declare unto you that which shall come upon you, for the Spirit hath come upon me.
And thereafter, Mattusala went and called all his brethren unto him; and he gathered together their generations; and unto all his children he declared the truth.
And he said, "My children, hearken unto all the words of your father; and, my friends, I shall instruct you, for I will speak unto you, and let the word of my mouth be established in truth."

And the law shall be your guide; walk therein; and let not your hearts be divided, nor draw near unto the law with two hearts; my children, walk in truth, and do not associate with those who have divided hearts.
She shall lead you in the good way; for I know that on the earth the body of violence shall be made to cease, and righteousness shall be your fellowship.
A great judgment shall be executed upon the earth; all iniquity shall be brought to an end; and from beneath it shall be removed.
The whole earth shall not pass away; iniquity shall be established; upon the earth it shall be executed; all works of iniquity and violence, and all works of wickedness shall be done away with.

Iniquity and sin, violence and wickedness, and all evil works shall abound; in the time of transgression and crime, wickedness shall be great, and a great judgment from heaven shall be executed upon all these.
The Holy Lord God shall come upon the earth to execute judgment with great wrath and vengeance.
In those days, violence shall be removed from beneath it; the works of iniquity shall be cast away with the wicked; and they shall perish beneath the heavens.

All shall be delivered to the nations; the wicked shall be consumed by fire; and all the earth shall be shaken; they shall be cast into the fire of hell. In the day of judgment and the eternal mighty wrath, they shall be destroyed.
The righteous shall rise from their sleep; wisdom shall arise; and it shall be given to them; and from Him shall arise the works of iniquity.
The wicked shall be consumed by the sword; the transgressors shall be cast away from their places.
Those who commit violence and those who practice wickedness shall be consumed by the sword.

"And after this, the second righteous judgment shall be executed upon her, for the eighth time; and a true judgment shall be rendered against the oppressors, and to her shall a sword be given; and the mighty shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous."
"In the end, they shall rise from their righteousness, and they shall make a dwelling for the King of Glory, to be praised forever."
"And after this, in the ninth judgment, she shall reveal a true judgment to all the world."
"And all the works of the wicked shall perish from the earth; and the world shall be counted for destruction; and all men shall behold the way of the righteous."
"And after this, in the tenth judgment, the judgment of eternity shall be executed in the seventh part."
"A great judgment shall come forth from among all the angels, and it shall be rendered in the heavenly realm by the archangels."
"The former heaven shall pass away completely; and the new heaven shall be revealed. And all the host of heaven shall shine like seven lights for eternity."
"After this, there shall be many judgments that are not numbered, which shall be for eternity in His mercy and forgiveness; and after that, sin shall not be committed forever."
"Now, my children, I will speak to you; I will show you the ways of righteousness and the ways of violence."
"And I will show you what is to come; now, my children, hear me; walk in the ways of righteousness."
"All who walk in the path of wickedness shall perish forever; therefore, do not walk in the ways of violence."
"Among all men, the most honorable, and the teacher of all the earth, is he who has written the teachings of wisdom, a book written by Enoch."
"To all who dwell upon the earth, to my children, and to those who execute judgment and peace for their children after them."
"The Holy One and the Blessed One grants days to all; let not your spirits be troubled in the ages."
"The righteous man shall arise from his sleep; and he shall walk in the paths of righteousness."
"His way, and all his actions, are of grace and eternal mercy; the righteous shall be forgiven; for him, and for the eternal, shall truth be given; and power shall be granted unto him."

"He shall dwell in grace and righteousness; and light shall be his dwelling forever; and sin shall perish in darkness until eternity; from this day forth, until the end of time, it shall not be seen."
"After this, it came to pass that Enoch began to speak from the books."
"Enoch, concerning his children and the choices of the world, concerning righteousness and true judgment, spoke thus: 'My children, I will speak these things to you; I will instruct you.'"
"I will declare to you the vision which I saw from heaven, and the word which I received from the holy angels, and that which I have understood upon the heavenly tablet."
And Enoch began to speak from the scriptures, saying, "I am the seventh generation, born in the beginning of the first generation."
Until judgment and truth are executed, the Lord shall be exalted; and after me, in the second generation, a great sin shall be committed.
The deceitful shall be concealed; and in her, the end of the first shall be accomplished.
And a man shall be deceived by her; and he, after being deceived, shall perish; and he shall act according to the law of transgression.
After this, in the third generation, at its end, a man shall be chosen for true judgment; and after him, the righteousness and truth of the world shall be revealed.

After this, in the fourth generation, at its end, the visions of the saints and the righteous shall be revealed. The law and the decree shall be established for the children of children throughout the ages.
After this, in the fifth generation, at its end, the praise and the house of the kingdom shall endure forever.
After this, in the sixth generation, all those who dwell in her shall be robbers; and their hearts shall be devoid of wisdom; and in her, man shall be destroyed.
And in her end, the house of the kingdom shall be consumed by fire; and all those chosen of the kingdom shall be destroyed in her.
After this, in the seventh generation, her transgressor and her work shall arise as a great generation; and all her work shall be iniquity.
In the end, for all creation, the chosen righteous shall be selected as a tree of righteousness from eternity, which provides seven teachings.
Who among the children of men is able to hear the holy word and is not known? Who is able to think of the thoughts of the heart?
Who is able to see the heavens and all their works clearly?

Who is able to know the works of heaven? If his soul does not see, or if it does not speak, or if it does not ascend to the heights and consider all their sides, or if it does not act like them, who is able to do so?
Who among all men is able to know what the earth's width and length is?

To whom has it been revealed that all these things are sent? Who is able to know the depth and length of heaven, how it is, and what the measure of the stars is, how many there are, and where all the lights are as they shine? If there is a man who can know all this, it is in him.
አሁንም ልጆቼ፥ እላችኋለሁ፤ ጽድቅን ውደዱአት፤ በእርሷም ሂዱ፤ የጽድቅ መንገዶችን ይቀበሏቸው ዘንድ ይገባልና፤
የዐመፅ መንገዶችም ፈጥነው ይጠፋሉ፤ ያንሳሉም፤ ለታወቁ ሰዎችም ከልጅ ልጅ ጀምሮ የዐመፅና የሞት መንገዶች ይገለጣሉ፤ ከእነርሱም ይርቃሉ፤ አይከተሏቸውምም።
አሁንም ለእናንተ ለጻድቃን እላችኋለሁ፤ በክፉ መንገዶች አትሂዱ፤ በግፍዕና በሞት መንገድም አትሂዱ፤ እንዳትጠፉም ወደ እነርሱ አትቅረቡ፤ ነገር ግን የተመረጠች ጽድቅንና ሕይወትን ለእናንተ ፈልጉ፤ ምረጡም።
በሰላም መንገዶችም ሂዱ፤ ትድናላችሁ፤ በተድላም ትኖራላችሁ፤ በልቡናችሁም ዐሳብ ትይዛላችሁ።
ክፉ ጥበብን ይሠሩ ዘንድ ኃጥኣን ሰዎችን እንደሚፈትኗቸው አውቃለሁና ነገሬ ከልቡናቸሁ አይጥፋ፤ ቦታም ሁሉ አይገኝላትም፤ መከራም ሁሉ አይጐድልም።
ዐመፅንና ግፍን ለሚያንጹ፥ ተንኰልንም ለሚሠሯት ሰዎች ወዮላቸው! እነርሱ ፈጥነው ይጠፋሉና፥ ሰላምም የላቸውምና።
ቤታቸውን በኀጢአት ለሚሠሩ ሰዎች ወዮላቸው! ከመሠረታቸው ሁሉ ይጠፋሉና፥ በሰይፍም ይወድቃሉና፥ ወርቅንና ብርንም የሚሰበስቧት በፍርድ ፈጥነው ይጠፋሉና።
እናንተ ባለጠጎች ወዮላችሁ! በባለጠግነታችሁ ላይ ታምናችኋልና፥ ከባለጠግነታችሁም ትለያላችሁና።
በባለጠግነታችሁ ወራት ልዑልን አላሰባችሁትምና፥ እናንተስ ስድብን፥ በደልንም ሠራችኋት፤ ደም ለሚፈስባት ቀንና ለጨለማዋ ቀን፥ ለታላቅዋ ፍርድ ቀንም የተዘጋጃችሁ ሆናችኋል።
የፈጠራችሁ እንደሚያጠፋችሁ፥ በውድቀታችሁም ላይ ይቅርታው እንደማይደረግላችሁ እኔ እንደዚህ ብዬ እነግራችኋለሁ።
Your Creator rejoices in your destruction; and your righteous ones shall be as a refuge for the wicked and for the sinners in those days.

My eyes shall be as clouds that pour forth water; and upon you shall be a great darkness; and my tears shall flow like a cloud of rain, and from my heart shall come forth strength; who was it that gave me this?
Who has given you to do evil and to commit iniquity? The wicked shall find judgment against you.
Fear not, O righteous ones, for you shall rise above the wicked; as they bring forth judgment against you, the Lord shall swiftly turn it back upon their own hands.
Woe unto you, for you shall not escape; for your iniquities have separated you from your God.
Woe unto you, for you shall repay evil for good; according to the measure of your deeds, so shall it be measured unto you.
Woe unto you, for you shall bear false witness, and for the wicked, you shall be ensnared; your haste shall lead to your destruction.
Woe unto you, O wicked ones! You shall oppress the righteous, and you shall fall into their hands; from the depths shall you be cast down, and their judgment shall prevail against you.
O righteous ones, take hope; the wicked shall swiftly perish from before you, for as you have been judged, so shall it be against them.
And on the day when the wicked shall be gathered, your children shall rise up like eagles; they shall soar high.
Your refuge shall be more secure than the place of the spider; and your flight shall be like that of the locusts, rising before the oppressors, and you shall be as a shadow unto the everlasting.
They shall cry out against you; this shall be your iniquity as a witness against you, but you shall not be as they are; you shall not be one with the wicked; they shall be as chaff.
Yet you, who receive affliction, fear not; for it shall be your poverty, and the light of the heavens shall shine upon you; and from heaven, you shall hear the word of rest.
Woe unto you, O sinners! For your iniquity shall make the righteous to be as a mirror unto you, and your hearts shall be filled with wickedness.
This matter shall be a reminder of your transgressions, and it shall stand as a witness against you.
Woe unto you who eat the fruit of the wheat, and from the source you draw strength; woe unto you who oppress the weak with your might!
Woe unto you who continually drink water! Your hastiness shall be your downfall, and you shall lose the source of life.
Woe unto you who commit iniquity and sin, and who perform abominations! This shall be a reminder of your transgressions against you.
Woe unto you who oppress the righteous with strength! The day of your destruction shall surely come upon you.
In those days, on the day of your judgment, many shall come forth, both the righteous and the wicked, to stand before the righteous.
The righteous shall believe; for the wicked shall be for destruction, and on the day of judgment, they shall perish.
The Most High will consider your destruction, and the angels in heaven will rejoice over your downfall; this shall be known to you.
O wicked ones, what will you do? When you hear the prayers of the righteous, where will you flee on that day of judgment?
In those days, the prayers of the saints shall reach unto God; but for you, your days of punishment shall come upon you.
All your deeds shall be laid bare before the Holy One; your faces shall be filled with fear; on the day of judgment, all that is hidden shall be revealed.
In the midst of the sea and in every place, woe unto you, O wicked ones, for your evil remembrance is upon you!
Truly, you gather silver and gold that is not yours; you oppress the poor; you say that all you possess is wealth, woe unto you!
We have gathered brightness, and it has adorned our garments; and those who dwell in our houses have been as water poured out; now you say, let us do what we have thought, woe unto you!
Your deceit shall flow like water; your integrity shall not be found in you; yet it shall swiftly perish from you. All shall be gathered in judgment against you.
And you shall be given unto great sorrow.
Today, I speak unto the foolish and unto the simple; for ye shall see many things upon the earth.
Ye men shall adorn yourselves more than women, and indeed, ye shall make a more beautiful adornment than that of the woman.
In governance and in authority, in power, in silver and in gold, in white linen, and in honor shall ye adorn yourselves.
The fools shall be as water that is poured out; therefore, they have neither instruction nor wisdom.
And then they shall perish together with their wealth and their nobility, and with all their glory.
In calamity and in distress, their great and wicked souls shall be cast into the fire.
O foolish one, as a mountain is not a servant, so shall it not be henceforth; and as a woman is not a servant to another woman, so I say unto you.
Likewise, sin hath not been sent upon the earth; but behold, men have created it for themselves; and those who have committed it shall be for great destruction.
For unto the woman no reason was given; but behold, if she work with her hands and bear not a child, she shall die.
O foolish ones, I speak unto you in your holiness and in your purity; for all your evil deeds are revealed in the heavens, and there is no wicked work that is hidden or concealed.
Do not be like your spirits; for in the heavens, before the Most High, each day your sins shall be written, so that you may not know them nor see them, and let not your hearts speak of them.
All the wicked deeds you commit shall be recorded each day until the day of your judgment, and from today onward, you shall know them.
Woe unto you, O sinners! For in your transgressions, you shall perish, and do not be deceived by the wise, nor shall good things be found among you.
Even now, know that you are prepared for the day of destruction; you shall go forth in your wickedness, but do not hope that you may be spared.
You do not know the judgment, and you shall perish. For your souls are prepared for the great day of judgment, for the great day of tribulation and distress is upon you.

Woe unto you, who commit evil deeds and consume riches! In your hearts and your desires, what good thing do you seek? Is there not a good thing greater than all that is upon the earth? Yet, peace is not with you.
Woe unto you, who love the works of the wicked! For what hope do you have in good things?
Know that you shall be given into the hands of the righteous, lest it be said that you are not; your ears shall be cut off, and they shall not spare you.
Woe unto you, who rejoice in the affliction of the righteous! For a grave shall not be opened for you.
Woe unto you, who despise the matters of the righteous! For the hope of life shall not be yours.
ሐሰት ነገርንና የዝንጉዎችን ነገር የምትጽፉ ወዮላችሁ! እነርሱ ስንፍናን እንዲሰሟትና እንዳይዘነጓት ሐሰታቸውን ይጽፋሉና።
ሰላምም አይሆንላቸውም፤ ነገር ግን ሳይዘገዩ ፈጥነው ሞትን ይሞታሉ።
ኀጢአትን የምትሠሩ፥ የሐሰትን ነገር የምታመሰግኑና የምታከብሩም ወዮላችሁ! በዚሁም ጠፋችሁ፤ ሕይወትና በጎ ነገርም የላችሁም።
የቅን ፍርድ ነገሮችን የሚለዋውጡ ወዮላቸው! የዘለዓለም ሥርዐትንም ይለውጣሉ፤ ራሳቸውንም ኀጢአተኞች እንዳልሆኑ የሚያደርጉ በምድር ላይ ይረገጡ ዘንድ አላቸው።
The righteous, in those days, prepare yourselves to receive your prayers for remembrance.
As the wicked stand before the Most High to be remembered for their sins, so shall you also bear witness before the angels.
In those days, the nations shall be remembered, and on the day of destruction, the generations of the nations shall rise.
In those days, the oppressed shall come forth; they shall take their children, and they shall plead for their children.
And from among them, they shall carry away their children; while they are being watched, they shall plead for their children.
And they shall not return to them, nor shall they show mercy to those whom they love.
Again, I say unto you, O wicked ones, I declare unto you, that on the day when blood shall be shed without measure, sin is prepared.
They shall be made to serve stone, and the likeness of gold and silver, and the likeness of wood and clay shall they create.
For the idols of the heavens and for the wicked, for all the abominations, and for every false god, they shall serve.
From among them, no deliverance shall be found; for their hearts shall be hardened, and in their hearts, fear shall cause their eyes to be dimmed.
ሕልማቸውንም በማየት ይረሳሉ፥ ይፈራሉም፤ ሥራቸውን ሁሉ በሐሰት ሠርተዋልና፥ ለድንጋዩም ሰግደዋልና፥ ፈጥነውም ይጠፋሉና።
በእነዚያም ወራቶች የጥበብን ነገር የሚቀበሉና የሚያውቋት ሁሉ ብፁዓን ናቸው።
የልዑልንም ሥራዎች ይሠሯቸዋል፥ በጽድቅም መንገድ ይሄዳሉ። እነርሱ ይድናሉና ከሚዘነጉ ሰዎች ጋር አይዘነጉም።
ለወንድማችሁ ክፉውን የምትዘረጉ ወዮላችሁ! በሲኦል ትጠፋላችሁና።
የኀጢአትንና የተንኰልን መሠረት የምትሠሩ፥ በምድርም ላይ የምታሳዝኑ ወዮላችሁ! በእርሱ ትጠፋላችሁና።
በባዕድ ገንዘብ ቤታችሁን የምትሠሩ ወዮላችሁ! ሥራቸውም ሁሉ ጡብ ነው፥ የኀጢአትም ድንጋይ ነው፤ ሰላም እንደሌላችሁም እኔ እነግራችኋለሁ።
ለዘለዓለም የሚኖር የአባቶቻቸውን ድንበርና ርስት ለሚያፈርሱ ወዮላቸው! ለእነርሱም ዕረፍት አይደረግላቸውምና ልቡናቸውን ወደ ጣዖቱ ይወስዱታል።
ዐመፅን የምትሠሯትና ግፍን የምትረዷት፥ እስከ ታላቋ የፍርድ ቀንም ድረስ ባልንጀሮቻችሁን የምትገድሉ፥ ወዮላችሁ! ክብራችሁን ይጥላልና፤ በልቡናችሁም ክፋትን ይጨምራልና።
ሁላችሁንም በሰይፍ ያጠፋችሁ ዘንድ የቍጣውን መንፈስ ያስነሣል፥ ቅዱሳንና ጻድቃን ሁሉም ኀጢአታችሁን ያስባሉ።
በእነዚያም ወራቶች አባቶች ከልጆቻቸው ጋር በአንድ ቦታ ይገደላሉ፤
And the brothers shall fall into death, as water is poured out until it is consumed, even as a man shall not withhold his hand from his son or from his son's son in bitterness.
The sinner shall not withhold his hand from his esteemed brother; from the evening until the sun rises, they shall contend.
The horse shall run in the blood of the wicked until they are consumed; the serpent shall give its venom until it is satisfied.
In those days, the angels shall descend to the place where they are summoned.
All that which is to be judged shall be gathered unto one place.
The Most High shall judge all the wicked with a great judgment; on that day, they shall rise.
The holy angels shall give guardianship over the saints and the righteous; they shall keep watch over them until all evil and all sin are consumed, as the eye keeps watch.
The righteous shall not fear even if they sleep long, for there is nothing that they dread.

The wise shall see the truth; the children of this world shall understand all that is written in this book, and in the time of their downfall due to their sins, they shall know that they cannot be saved.
Woe unto you, O wicked, on the day of great torment when the righteous are troubled! You shall be consumed by fire, and according to your deeds, you shall receive your recompense.
ክፉውን ነገር ልብ ታደርጉ ዘንድ የምትተጉ ልበ ግልብጦች ወዮላችሁ! ፍራትም ያገኛችሁ ዘንድ አላችሁ፥ የሚረዳችሁም የለም።
ኃጥኣን፥ ወዮላችሁ! በአፋችሁ ነገር ላይና ሥራን በዘነጋችሁባቸው በእጆቻችሁ ሥራ ላይ በእሳት ወላፈን ትቃጠላላችሁና።
አሁንም ዕወቁ፥ መላእክት በሰማይ ከፀሐይና ከጨረቃ፥ ከከዋክብትም የተነሣ ስለ ኀጢአታችሁ ሥራችሁን ይመራመራሉና።
በምድር ላይ በጻድቃን ዘንድ ፍርድን ታደርጉባቸዋላችሁና ደመናውንና ጉሙን ሁሉ፥ ጠሉንና ዝናቡንም በእናንተ ያዳኝባችኋል፤ ወደ እናንተ እንዳይወርዱ ሁሉ ከእናንተ ይከለከላሉና፥ በኀጢአታችሁም አያስቡምና።
አሁንም ዝናብ ወደ እናንተ መውረድን እንዳይከለከል፥ ጠልም ከእናንተ ወርቅንና ብርን ተቀብሎ እንዲወርድ ለዝናም እጅ መንሻን ስጡ።
ውርጭና ዐመዳይ፥ የእነርሱም ቅዝቃዜ፥ የዐመዳይ ነፋሳትም ሁሉ፥ የእነርሱም ጭንቅ ሁሉ ቢወድቁባችሁ በእነዚያ ወራቶች በፊታቸው መቆም አይቻላችሁም።

O ye children of heaven, lift up the heavens, and exalt all the works of the Most High; fear Him who has risen from among them; and do not commit evil before Him; fear Him who has risen from among them.
If the heavens should be shaken, and the rain and the floods should not descend upon the earth because of you, what will you do to avert it?
If He should send the season upon you and upon all your works, would you not be those who are born of Him?
In His goodness, you speak of great and wondrous things, yet you have no peace.
As one rises from the midst of the storm, so do their ships rise from the winds; and as they are tossed, do not the kings who sail upon the ships see them?
Their good treasures all go forth with them to the sea, therefore they fear.
The sea will rise against them, and within it they shall perish; yet in their hearts they do not think of good; all the seas, and all its waters, do they not perform the works of the Most High?
He has established all their works and their waters, and He has confined their depths.
In their doing, they shall be troubled; all their fish shall die, and all that is within it shall perish.
You who dwell upon the earth, be not afraid; for He who created the heavens and the earth, and all that is within them, is not He?
Who has given instruction and wisdom to all who traverse the sea? Are not those who sail upon the ships fearful of the sea? Yet the wicked do not fear the Almighty.
In those days, if a dreadful fire were to increase upon you, where would you flee? Where would you find refuge?
When the word abides upon you, do you not tremble and fear? Are not all lights trembling in great fear and are not they known?
The earth trembles in great fear, does it not quake and shudder?
All the angels shall fulfill that which they have been commanded, and they shall delight to stand before the face of the Lord of glory.
The children of the world shall be helped; they shall be known; and you, the wicked, are condemned for eternity, and peace is not with you.
You, the souls of the righteous, do not fear; for you are truly dead, place your hope.
Your souls, in great tribulation and outcry, do not grieve as they descend into Sheol.
Your flesh shall not find rest in your life as your righteousness has not been found; yet the time was that you were called wicked, a time of trial and tribulation.
In the time of your death, the wicked shall say unto you, “The righteous have died as we die; what is their advantage in their works?”

Behold, in sorrow and in affliction, as death is unto us, what shall be their end? From this day forth, what shall they encounter? What shall they behold for eternity? Behold, they have died, and from this day forth, they shall not see the light of eternity.
O ye wicked, thus do I speak unto you: "The bread and the drink of iniquity, the shedding of blood and the hoarding of wealth, lo, it is enough for you to witness the days of destruction."
How shall their end be peace, when the righteous shall not be spared? Until the day of their death, no violence shall be found against them.
Let them perish; let them be as if they were not created, and their bodies shall descend into the grave in anguish.
Today, I declare unto you, O righteous ones, in the greatness of His lordship and His glory, in the majesty of His kingdom and in His compassion.
For I know this mystery, and I have perceived what is in the heavenly tablet; and I am unable to declare that which the saints have written unto you.
In all good things, their joy and glory have been prepared for them; therefore, I have found them inscribed within themselves and set apart.

Truly and in truth, concerning many good things, the souls of those who have died are inscribed; and the worth of your weak ones shall be given unto you; and your fortune shall be multiplied beyond that of the living.
Concerning the righteousness of your death, your souls shall be preserved; and their souls shall rejoice; and they shall be filled with joy.
Their remembrance shall endure before God from generation to generation; fear not now their afflictions.
Woe unto you, O mighty ones, at the time you die in your iniquity!
As they are, so shall they say unto you; the mighty are indeed wicked; their time shall not be prolonged.

Today, by goodness and by the might of death; they have not seen their affliction and their calamity in their lifetime; and by the greatness of death, judgment has not been executed upon them in their lifetime.
Their souls descend into Sheol; and their torment shall be as a strong affliction; do you not know this?
Your bodies shall enter into darkness and into filth; they shall be brought to the strong judgment; and the strong judgment shall be upon all the generations of the world.
Peace be upon you, and woe unto you! To those who are alive, let it not be said to the righteous and to the poor, “In the days of our affliction, we are afflicted.”
We have seen all the afflictions; we have received many afflictions; we have been consumed and have perished; our bodies have become diminished; we have also perished.
And in the matter, there is none to help us; in our labor, we are afflicted; we have found nothing, we have been distressed; we have also perished.
From today, we have made hope to see life; we have made hope to be heads; but indeed, let us be humble; even when we labor, we are afflicted.
Nevertheless, concerning our weakness, we have not fulfilled our obligations; for the wicked, let them be as lamps; and the sinners, let them honor their days.
Those who call upon us and those who pursue us have set traps for us; for those who call upon us, we have made our necks low; yet they have not spared us.
Let us flee from them and run away, that we may go to our refuge; and from them, we have not found a place to flee.

In our afflictions, during the time of our leaders, they have mocked us; and concerning those who call upon us, they have raised their voices; yet our cries they have not heard; and our words they do not desire to listen to.
Those who dwell with us, who feed us, who protect us, He shall deliver them; He shall carry their burdens; their days shall not be taken away from us; yet indeed, they shall be fed.
"They have oppressed us; they have slain us; they have taken our lives; yet they do not consider that their hands are raised against us."
"O righteous ones! I declare unto you; the angels in the presence of the Lord of glory think well of you."
"Your names shall be written in the presence of the Lord of glory. For beforehand, in sin and in weakness, they have been cast down, therefore take hope."
"Even now, as you are illuminated like the brightness of heaven, the gates of heaven shall be opened unto you."
"Your cry shall be heard; cry out for judgment; it shall be revealed unto you; and all your troubles shall be made known to the angels and to those who are sent to assist you."
"As the angels in heaven rejoice over you, so shall there be great joy; therefore take hope; do not cast away your hope, for on the great day of judgment, that which you have shall not be lost."
"Do not be as the wicked; for from among you shall come the eternal judgment for all generations."
"Even now, O righteous ones! Stand firm in your faith, and when you see them, do not be afraid."
"You are not to be one with the hosts of heaven; rather, stand apart from them, and do not join in their violence."
"You are the wicked! All our sins shall not be overlooked; they shall not be written against us, you say; however, indeed, all your sins shall be written daily, and they are not absent."
And now, both light and darkness, day and night, shall reveal all your iniquities; therefore, I shall show you. And let not your hearts be troubled; do not be dismayed.

Do not return to matters of judgment; do not commit falsehood concerning the holy and the sacred; do not honor your idols, for all your falsehoods and all your deceit are for great iniquity and not for righteousness.
Today, I know this mystery; for many shall return to the matters of judgment, and they shall be made known.
They shall speak of evil things; they shall create great hearts and speak deceitfully; and upon their words, they shall write their writings.

But indeed, all my matters were written in truth, as they were in their own words; and concerning my matters, they shall not be altered nor changed, for I had previously declared all that I had written in truth.
I also know another mystery; for the righteous and the wise shall receive books concerning joy and concerning righteous judgment, for many wise writings shall be given to them.

To them shall be given books; and they shall believe in them; and they shall rejoice in them; and they shall do righteousness; and all the righteous shall know all the ways of truth, and they shall find their worth.
In those days, the Lord shall call upon them and shall instruct their wisdom for the children of the earth.
"You are their leaders, and you are gifts upon the whole earth; show them."
I and my son shall be one with them in the ways of truth for everlasting life; and peace shall be upon you, O children of truth! Truly, rejoice in truth.
After many days, my son Matusalal took a wife for his son Lamih; and she bore him a son, a male child.
His body was as white as snow, and red like the blooming rose; his hair was as white as the wool of a lamb; it was unshorn; and his eyes were bright.

And when his eyes were opened, the whole house shone like the sun; and the entire house was filled with light; and when he arose from his bed, he opened his mouth, and the glory of the Lord of righteousness was proclaimed.
His father Lamih arose and ran, and came to his father Matusalal; and he said, "I have given birth to a son; he is not like a man."
The angels of heaven resemble children; and the creation is unique; they are not like us; their eyes are like the shining sun; and their faces are radiant.
It is from the angels that he seems to have been born, for I fear that on the earth, in my time, he will not perform wondrous deeds.
"Now my father, you will go to our father Henok, and you will hear the truth from him; I will instruct you. For his dwelling is with the angels."
And when Matusalal heard the matter concerning his son, I was there as if I were present, and he came down to the earth and approached me.
He cried out; and I heard his word. And I went to him; and I said, "You have come to me, my son; behold, I am here."
And he answered me, saying, "I have come to you because of a great matter and because of a distressing vision that has come upon you."

Now, my Father! Hear me; for my form and creation are not like that of a man, but my form is more radiant than snow, and more beautiful than the dawn; and my own crown is more resplendent than the whiteness of the snow, and my eyes shine like the sun, for I have been born to my son, your servant.
And when his eyes were opened, he illuminated his entire house; he arose from the presence of his Lord, and with his mouth he praised the Lord of heaven.
His father, having been distressed, fled to me; for he resembled one born of angels from heaven, but I did not believe that he was born of him.
Behold, I have come to you that you may declare the truth to me.”

And I, Enoch, answered concerning him, saying, “The Lord shall do a new thing upon the earth; for the words of the Lord, which are above the children of my father Jared, have been declared from heaven, and this I have seen in a vision, and I have not spoken of it to you.”

They shall commit sin; they shall transgress the law; they shall be one with women; and with them they shall commit sin; they shall take wives from among them; they shall beget children from them; and great destruction shall come upon all the earth.
The waters of destruction shall descend; and a great destruction shall occur in one year; for to you a son is born; he shall remain upon the earth; and his three sons shall be with him.
When all men upon the earth shall die, he shall remain; and his sons shall bear children, and these shall be fleshly, but they shall not be spiritual.
A great judgment shall come upon the earth; and the earth shall be delivered from all destruction.

“Now this son that is born is indeed your son; tell your son, your servant, that he shall remain with you; for he shall be a remnant, and you shall call his name Noah; for in his days the earth shall be cleansed from all sin and all death; he and his sons shall remain from the destruction that shall come upon the earth. After this, upon the earth, a greater judgment shall occur than that which has been previously executed; for I know the mysteries of the saints. He has revealed Himself to me, and He has shown me; I have seen in the heavenly tablet; I have understood.”

"Verily, the true lineage shall prevail until the end, for lineage is greater than lineage itself; it shall flourish, and I have seen that which is written concerning them; by iniquity shall it perish; sin shall abound upon the earth; and all good things shall come upon her; even now, this child that is born is indeed his son, for it is not a lie; go thou and tell thy son, and thy mother, of these things." And when Matusalem heard the matter concerning his father, the work was shown to him in silence, and having heard the matter, he returned.
"For he shall deliver the earth from all its destruction, and that child's name is Noah."
This is the second book written by Enoch for his son Methuselah, concerning those who shall come after him and for those who shall keep the commandments in the days to come.

As for the wicked who perform evil deeds, until they are finished, and until the army of the wicked is completed, you shall remain well, you who have done good, for in those days you shall be preserved.

But you, until sin has overtaken you, shall be like a door that is shut. For their name shall be made known from the book in which the saints are written, and their seed shall perish forever. Their children shall die, and they shall be cast out into the wilderness, crying out; and they shall be consumed by fire, for there shall be no land for them.
I saw the fire of their torment, and it was burning; it was as if the mountains were consumed by fire, and there were things that were honored. And there, and here, they shall be known.

I asked one of the holy angels who were with me, saying, "What is this that burns? For it is not heaven, but it is only the fire of torment, the cry and the lamentation, the wailing and the great pain."
And he said to me, "This place that you see is for the sinners and the transgressors, those who commit sin."
The place where the souls of those who are to be judged are cast down is the place where all those who are called to be changed shall dwell.

The angels shall be sent to them, and the souls of the sinners and the transgressors shall be brought to them, that they may know what is theirs; for above them in heaven are those who are written and are preserved.

But they shall suffer in their flesh, having received a price from the Creator, having risen from the wicked, and having loved their Creator's gold and silver; thus they do not love any good thing that is in this world. But they have given their flesh to torment; from the moment they were created, they have not desired the food that is in this world, and they have made themselves like a dead body. Keep this in mind, for the Lord has tested them many times; and they shall be blessed that their bodies may be found in purity.
And I spoke concerning all their blessings in the scriptures; for you, from the beginning of their eternal life, when they love the heavenly one...
When the wicked receive affliction, and when they hear of their deeds and their calamities, they have been found to give thanks to me, and they have rendered their worth unto themselves.

Now I shall call upon the souls of the dogs that were born of the children of light, for their faith is fitting, and they have not received honor in their flesh, and I shall cast them into darkness for those who were born therein.

And I shall bring forth those who have loved my holy name in the bright light; and I shall place each one in a throne of honor according to their dignity, for the judgment of God is true, and it shall shine upon them in other ages.
For in the straight paths, a dwelling shall be given to the faithful, and they shall be granted faith.
The righteous, as they are being honored, shall see those who were born in darkness when they are cast into darkness; and the wicked, as they cry out, shall see the righteous being honored.
They shall dwell in the days and ages that have been written for them.
